tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ smin byed dbang dang grol lam phyag rgya chen po'i gnad don gyi dri ba lan du phul ba skal bzang dga' byed bdud rtsi'i 'dod 'jo bzhugs so/ 156)༄༅/ no mo gu ru sa mā dā na a dwa ya bh+yaḥ{ lha dang bla ma gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ } 'gro khams gdod nas bde gshegs snying po'i rgyud// lhun gyis grub kyang lhan skyes ling tog gis// ldongs la ye shes rang gsal bde blag tu// ston mdzad bla ma bde chen 'khor lo mchod// lus can thar par 'dren pa'i chos kyi sgo// bsam mi khyab kyang myur lam nges ster ba// gsang mchog rdo rje'i theg las gzhan med na// de don bka' mchid gleng mo 'dir bgyid do// thos bsam sgom pa'i nus bral rmongs rgan la// zab don 157)ji bzhin smra ba'i rgyu med kyang*// rnam 'dren mchog khyed gzhan la phan slad thugs// rnam par dkar bas dris la lan 'di 'bul/ de yang skye ba nas skye bar dam pa'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba'i bstan 'gro'i 'dod ster gyi nor bur gyur pa'i chos kyi rje mi pham mgon po'i mtshan 'chang ba gang nyid/ shes bya'i chos rnams la gzigs pa dri ma med pa'i spyan yangs pa la som nyi'i rab rib kyi mtshan mas dben mod kyang*/ phyi rabs kyi gang zag dam pa'i chos la yid 'jug pa dag la phan 158)dgongs kyi thugs thabs la mkhas pa'i phrin las kyi sgo 'phar phyes nas/ bdag la gsang sngags smin grol gnyis kyi gnad don 'ga' zhig dri ba'i tshul mdzad pa la brten na/ rmongs pa bdag gis go tshul 'ol tshod kyi tshig 'ga' gsol bar bgyi ba/ ma rtogs log rtog gi 'gal 'khrul mchis na/ chos dbyings bsam mi khyab pa'i dgongs klong zab mor bzod par bzhes su gsol/ de yang nyid kyi dri tshig yongs rdzogs su 'dir bkod na rjes 'jug rnams go bsla zhing 'brel chags par 'gyur na'ang*/ mi rgan yi ge'i khur la 'dzem ste gnad don 'gag bsdus su bkod nas 'bul bar bya ba las/

thog mar/ smin byed dbang gi ngo bo dang*/ thob mtshams kyi bye brag sogs/ rgyud sde'i lung 'dren dang bcas pa gnang nas dri bar mdzad pa'i lan don la/ spyi dang khyad par gnyis las/ 159)spyir ni/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos thams cad kyi 'jug sgo ni smin grol gnyis la rag las pa dang*/ de las kyang thog mar smin byed kyi dbang ma thob par rgyud lung man ngag gi tshig sho lo ka tsam yang nyan par mi dbang zhing*/ 'chad nyan byed pa po la byin rlabs mi 'byung bar ma zad/ gsang sgrog gi ltung ba sogs nyes pa tshad med pa dang*/ gal te dbang ma thob bzhin du grol byed nyams su len par rloms na'ang*/ dngos grub mi thob cing bar chad kyi rgyu rkyen du 'gyur tshul sogs skyon mtha' yas par gsungs te/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las/ dper na pi wang sbyar kun tshogs// rgyud dang bral na brdung mi rung*// de bzhin dbang dang bral gyur pas// sngags dang bsam gtan 'grub mi 'gyur/ zhes sogs dang*/ rdor sems snying gi rgyud las/ gsang sngags dbang la ma brten 160)'grub mi 'gyur// dper na gnyan pa lag skya med pas ni// chu yi pha rol sgrol bar mi nus bzhin/ zhes sogs dbang ma thob pa'i skyon grangs med par gsungs pa dang*/ thob pa'i phan yon kyang*/ snying gi me long las/ dbang rnams rab tu thob byas na/ gsang sngags thams cad ma sgrub 'grub/ ces dang*/ klong gsal gyi rgyud las/ dbang thob rigs kyi bu de nyid// tshe 'dir bsam pa kun 'grub cing*// phyi ma mngon par rdzogs sangs rgya/ zhes sogs kyi lung brjod las 'das mod cing*/ de lta bu'i dbang de nyid kyang rgyu'am sa bon rang gi rgyud la gdod ma nas lhun grub tu yod pa de nyid/ rkyen bla ma'i byin rlabs dang*/ brda thabs kyis mngon par 'du byed pa nyid de/ dper na/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rgyal sar dbang bskur bar byed pa la/

gang la bskur ba de rgyal po'i rigs ma nor ba yin pa 161)zhig dgos la/ de ltar yin du zin kyang rgyal sar ma bkod kyi ring la ni rgyal bu zhes brjod pa ma gtogs rgyal por mi 'gyur zhing*/ nam zhig rgyal srid la dbang bskur ba de phyin chad du rgyal po dngos su 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ 'dir yang slob ma'i khams rgyud la dbang bzhi'i sa bon ye nas yod kyang*/ dbang gi smin par ma byas kyi bar du ye shes mngon du mi 'gyur la/ nam smin grol gyi lam la chud tshe rang rgyud kyi ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba ste/ glang po chur 'jug gi rgyud phyi ma las/ 'gro ba'i sems nyid rang rig 'od gsal don// sangs rgyas ma bcos lhun grub gnas pa'i rgyud// don gsal smin cing grol ba'i lam zhugs na// 'bras bu rang rgyud gsal bar mthong ba yin/ zhes pa ltar yin pa dang*/ dbang de nyid la yang*/ ngo bo dang*/ nges tshig dang*/ 162)dbye ba dang*/ dgos byed dang bzhis ston te/ dang po dbang gi ngo bo ni/ dbang gi chu bo bzhi 'dus kyi rgyud las/ dag dang smin dang rgyud sbyong dang*// ye shes gzhug par bya ba dang*// bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa thob pa'i// 'bras bu rgyud la 'jog pa yin/ zhes pa ltar rang la yod pa'i ye shes rang gsal du bya ba'i thabs kyi rgyal po yin no/ nges chatshag ni/ rang gi sgo gsum bag chags 'khrul phyir 'brang ste rang dbang ma thob pa las/ thabs 'dis sku bzhi dbyer med kyi go 'phang la rang dbang thob par byed pa'i phyir na dbang zhes brjod pa ste/ 'di nyid saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du a bhi ṣīñtsa zhes bya la/ de nyid bod skad du rang sor bsgyur na/ dri ma bkru ba zhes bya bar 'gyur ba ste/ dbang bzhi'i nus pas lus ngag yid dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa'i dri ma bkru bas na de ltar du brjod 163)pa dang*/ yang*/ a bhi ṣe ka ta zhes skal ba 'jog pa la 'jug ste/ skal ba gang ltar 'jog na/

bum dbang gi lus lhar sgom pa'i skal ba 'jog de bzhin du gsang ba'i dbang gi rtsa rlung sgom pa dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gis bde stong lhan skyes dang*/ tshig dbang rin po ches zung 'jug blo 'das bsgom pa'i skal ba 'jog pa'i phyir de skad brjod pa'o/ yang*/ a bhi sid+dhi zhes grub pa'am smin pa la 'jug ste/ gang ltar smin na/ bum dbang gi lus phung khams skye mched thams cad lha ru smin par byed pa dang*/ gsang dbang gis ngag rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum thams cad sngags kyi rang bzhin du smin pa dang*/ sher dbang gis khams thig le bde ba chen por dang*/ tshor ba mtha' dag lhan skyes ye shes su smin pa dang*/ tshig dbang gis snang srid dag 164)pa rab 'byams chos sku khyab gdal chen por smin par byed pa'i phyir/ dbang gi sgra don ni de lta bu'o/ dbye ba ni/ spyir rgyud sde'i rim pa'i khyad kyis dbang gi tshul yang tha dad pa ni/ ye shes thig ler/ chu yis dbang bskur dbu brgyan dbang*// bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags// rdo rje dril bu de bzhin ming*// spyod pa'i rgyud las rab tu gsal// phyir mi ldog pa yi ni dbang*// rnal 'byor rgyud du gsal bar byas/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ bya rgyud las chu cod pan dang*/ rig gtad sogs kyi snod rung du byed la/ spyod rgyud du de'i khar rdor dril ming dang bcas pas rig pa'i dbang lnga dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud du/ de steng phyir mi ldog pa slob dpon gyi dbang ngam/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang dang bcas pa bskur ba'i tshul ni gsang sngags gsar rnying spyi mthun yin la/ khyad par gsang sngags nang pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud las/ dbang 165)bzhi yongs rdzogs su bskur ba'i tshul yang bka' gsar rnying khyad med na'ang*/ bzhi po de'i nang bses kyi dbye ba mi 'dra ba du mar gsungs te/ gsar ma ltar na/ bde dgyes gsang gsum sogs ni phal cher mthun mod kyang*/

dus 'khor ltar na/ dang por khams lnga'i dri ma 'khrud cing yum lnga'i dngos grub bsgrub pa dang*/ sa dang po thob byed du bum chu'i dbang dang*/ phung po lnga'i dri ma sbyong zhing sangs rgyas lnga bsgrub pa dang*/ sa gnyis pa thob byed cod pan gyi dbang ste/ lus kyi sgrib pa sbyong zhing sku rdo rje thob pa'i sa bon 'jog byed kyi dbang gnyis/ de bzhin du rlung bcu'i dri ma sbyong zhing*/ nus pa sa bcu'i dngos grub dang*/ sa gsum pa thob byed dar dpyang gi dbang dang*/ rtsa ro rkyangagi dri ma sbyong zhing*/ gtso bo yab yum gyi dngos grub dang*/ sa bzhi pa thob byed 166) rdor dril gyi dbang dang gnyis kyi ngag sgrib dag cing gsung rdo rje'i sa bon rgyud la 'jog byed gnyis/ tshogs brgyad dbang po yul bcas kyi dri ma sbyong zhing*/ sems dpa' sems ma'i dngos grub dang*/ sa lnga pa thob byed brtul zhugs kyi dbang dang*/ las dang bya ba'i dri ma sbyong zhing khro bo khro mo'i dngos grub dang*/ sa drug pa thob byed ming gi dbang dang gnyis kyis yid sgrib dag cing*/ thugs rdo rje'i go 'phang thob pa'i nus pa 'jog rjes gnang mtha' rten dang bcas pas ni ye shes kyi khams la sgrib byed dri ma sbyong zhing*/ rigs bdag rdor sems yab yum kyi dngos grub dang*/ sa bdun pa thob cing*/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje'i go 'phang la sbyor ba ste/ de ltar bdun po 'di la byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun du grags shing*/ 'di dag thob pa'i rten gyi gang zag de ni sngags kyi dge bsnyen du 'gyur bar gsungs la/ 167)de nas bum dbang gi sa brgyad pa thob byed kyi nus pa 'jog cing*/ sngags kyi dge tshul du 'gyur ba dang*/ gsang dbang gis sa dgu pa thob cing sngags kyi dge slong du 'gyur ba dang*/ sher dbang gis sa bcu pa dang bcu gcig dbang bzhi pas sa bcu gnyis pa dang*/ skye dgu'i bdag po chen por 'gyur ba sogs/

de ltar rim pa 'dren tshul de bzhin gsungs mod la/ rgyud sde gzhan rnams su ni bum dbang la rig pa'i dbang lnga/ de mthar brtul zhugs rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang*/ de nas gsang ba/ shes rab ye shes/ tshig dbang rnams rim pa ltar dbye bar mdzad pa'i lugs mang ba dang*/ gsang sngags rnying ma ltar na/ dbang gi dbye tshul gnyis yin te/ byung tshul dang sgo bstun nas dbang gi tshul bzhir dbye ba dang*/ bskur tshul dang bstun nas dbang gi rim pa bzhin dbye 168)ba ste/ snga ma ni/ bka' po sti glegs bam gyi dbang dang*/ yi dam lha'i dbang dang*/ mkhas pa paṇ+ḍita'i dbang dang*/ rig pa rtsal gyi dbang dang bzhir bshad la/ phyi ma dbang bzhi'i rim pa ni bum gsang sher ye tshig dbang dang bzhi la/ so so'i nang tshan gyi dbye tshul ni/ de yang zhi khro sgyu 'phrul bskor gyi gzhung lugs lta bu'i dbang du bgyis na/ dbu rgyan cod pan 'phreng ba dang*// go cha rgyal mtshan phyag rgya dang*// gdugs dang bum pa bza' btung dang*// snying po lnga yi dbang bskur bya/ zhes pas/ phyi phan pa'i dbang bcu/ de nas 'chad pa dang*/ nyan pa dang*/ bsgrub pa dang*/ phrin las sna tshogs pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon du byed par nus pa dang bcas pas/ nang nus pa'i dbang lnga ste/ de ltar bco lnga po 'di bum dbang gi nang tshan yin la/ de rjes gsang ba'i dbang dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang*/ dbyer 169)med bde ba chen po'i dbang dang gsum la gsang ba zab mo'i dbang gsum zhes bya ste/ de ltar yongs dril bco brgyad du dbye ba dang*/ yang*/ bde gshegs snying po sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi gzhung ltar na/ khyad par ye shes kyi dbang dang*/ thun mong thugs rje'i dbang gnyis kyi/ dang po la/ phyi mtshon byed rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas bya spyod yar ldan gyi dbang rim brgyad/ nang lha tshogs bdun brgya nyer lnga la brten nas ma hā a nu byin rlabs yongs rdzogs kyi dbang rim dgu

gsang ba yab yum zung 'jug la brten nas byang sems yongs rdzogs sa lam myur bsgrod kyi dbang rim gsum/ yang gsang de kho na nyid rang rig ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rgyal thabs spyi blugs a ti yongs rdzogs kyi dbang rim drug ste/ de ltar ye shes kyi dbang nyer drug thun 170)mong thugs rje'i dbang la/ bka' rab 'byams nus pa'i dbang rim brgyad dang*/ phan pa'i dbang rim lnga ste bcu gsum/ de ltar rnam grangs spyi bsdoms su sum cu so dgu la/ nang bses phra mor phyes na dbang gi rnam grangs nyis brgya dang so bdun du yod pa'i dbye tshul dang*/ yang bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i chos skor gyi dbang chog smin byed snying gi me long gi gzhung ltar na/ phyi bum pa'i dbang la/ rig pa'i dbang lnga dang*/ mtha' rten lnga ste bcu dang*/ nang rdo rje rgyal po bka' rab 'byams kyi dbang brgya dang bcu bdun/ gsang ba rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang so bzhi/ yon tan rin po che dngos grub mchod rdzas kyi dbang nyer lnga/ phrin las 'gro 'dul bka' nyan las byed kyi dbang nyer gcig yongs su rdzogs pa bka' gtad rjes gnang gi dbang bdun te/ de dag spyir dril ba nyis brgya dang bcu gsum dbye 171)ba dang*/ yang*/ rnying lugs kyi dbang thams cad kyi gtso bo theg pa rim pa dgu'i spyi dbang du gyur pa/ 'dus pa mdo dbang chen mo'i lugs ltar na/ thog mar sngon 'gro sdig sgrib sbyong byed ngan song gnas 'dren gi dkyil 'khor la phyag rdor dang*/ rdor sems dbyer med gtso 'khor bcu gsum pa'i sgo nas mchog dbang chen mo bcu drug de nas mtho ris lha mi'i theg pa la dkyil 'khor bcu gcig zhal phye zhing dbang brgya dang nyer gsum/ nyan thos kyi theg pa la dkyil 'khor lnga dang dbang sum cu so dgu rang rgyal gyi theg pa la dkyil 'khor bzhi dang*/ dbang bzhi bcu zhe lnga/ byang sems smon 'jug theg pa la dkyil 'khor bcu dang*/

dbang lnga bcu nga gsum/ kṛ ya'i dkyil 'khor drug dang*/ dbang drug cu rtsa gnyis/ u pa ya'i theg par dkyil 'khor gcig dang*/ dbang nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ yo ga'i theg pa la rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sgo sbrags gnyis pa 172)dbang dgu bcu rtsa dgu de nas gsang sngags bla med ma hā yo ga'i theg pa la zhi khro gnyis las/ zhi ba la dkyil 'khor drug dang*/ dbang gi rnam grangs sum brgya drug cu rtsa gnyis/ khro bo la yang dkyil 'khor drug dang*/ dbang drug brgya bzhi bcu/ lung a nu yo ga'i theg pa la dkyil 'khor sgo sbrags bcu gcig pa dang*/ dbang gi rnam grangs brgyad brgya dang lnga cu rtsa lnga/ rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga la dkyil 'khor gcig dang*/ rig pa'i rtsal dbang bco brgyad/ de dag kun gyi mtha' rten dngos grub tshe dbang chen mo la dkyil 'khor gcig dang*/ dbang lnga cu rtsa brgyad dang bcas pa ste/ mdor na/ 'dus pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor sgro sbrags rnams so sor ma brtsis pa'i spyi sdoms su/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor lnga bcu rtsa bzhi/ cha gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dang lnga bcu rtsa lnga la/ lha grangs stong dang dgu brgya dang brgyad cu thams pa bzhugs shing*/ dbang gi rnam 173)grangs yongs dril nyis stong dang bzhi brgya bzhi bcu thams pa phyag bzhes su gtan la 'bebs par yod pa ste/ de ltar gsang sngags gsar rnying gnyis ka'i dbang gi rnam grangs 'di dag ni dbang bzhi'i nang tshan kho na'i dbye grangs yin gyi/ sngon 'gro sta gon gyi las rim dang*/ dngos bzhi bsgrub mchod dang*/ rjes mtha' rgyas kyi las rim sogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i sa bcad kyi rkang grangs ni ma yin te/ sa bcad de dag gi rnam grangs ni gsar rnying so so'i dbang gzhung re re la yang rgyas bsdus kyi bye brag mtha' yas mod cing*/ lar chos bka' re re la yang dbang chen dbang phran bsam gyis mi khyab par mchis na bgrangs kyi ga la langs te/

mdor bsdu na/ gsang sngags bla med kyi smin byed mtha' dag bum gsang sher ye tshig 174)dbang dang bzhi po nyid la ma 'dus pa ni gang yang ma mchis so/ skabs 'dir 'phros don la/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi dbang gzhung rnams su nyan thos rang rgyal gyi dbang sogs theg pa mtho dman thams cad kyi dbang bskur 'di dag la/ gsar ma'i mkhas pa mang pos dgag pa du ma mdzad pa byung mod kyi/ spyir ni gsang sngags ma gtogs mdo 'dul sogs las dbang bskur mi 'byung na'ang*/ 'dir ni sngags lam du chos thams cad kyi gzhung lam tshang zhing 'du bar ston pa'i skabs yin te/ rten gyi gang zag dbang rnon gcig char ba dag la ni sngags kyi nye lam 'ba' zhig gis chog na'ang*/ gzhan rim gyis pa rnams theg pa mas 'dzeg gi rim pas khrid thabs yin te/ brtag gnyis las kyang*/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya// de rjes bye brag smra ba bstan/ mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no/ zhes nyan thos 175)dang*/ de rjes rnal 'byor spyod pa bstan/ zhes theg chen dbu ma sogs dang*/ de rjes kyai yi rdo rje bstan/ zhes sngags dngos te/ de ltar rim can du ston tshul gsungs pa dang dgongs pa mthun zhing*/ gzhan yang dbang chog phal cher gyi sdom bzung gi skabs su'ang*/ tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ zhes sogs dang*/ so so thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa la// bdag ni rgyun du gnas shing bsrung*/ zhes pa rnams don gyi dgongs pa gcig pa las/ gnas skabs kyi las rim rgyas bsdus tsam du snang la 'di ltar thob pa'i gang zag de nyid 'dul ba rang rkang gi dge tshul slong gi tha snyad ni ma yin mod kyang*/ sngags kyi sdom pa gsum ldan tshang tshul ni/ gong du dus 'khor gyi dbang gi rim pa de nyid kho nas go bar 'gyur la/ yang theg pa'i rgyud tha dad kyi dkyil 'khor 176)dang dbang gi rnam grangs so so'i rang lugs ltar ma byas na/

thams cad bla med kho na'i lugs ltar bya ba mi 'thad snyam na/ theg rim dang rgyud sde'i rim pa gang yang 'og ma la gong ma 'du bar mi srid cing*/ gong ma la 'og ma thams cad 'du ba ni dper na/ blon po'i 'og tu rgyal po mi 'du la/ rgyal po'i 'og tu blon po 'du ba lta bu ste/ theg chen bla med kyi khongs su 'og ma thams cad yongs rdzogs su 'du ba chos nyid do/ 'on kyang*/ gsar ma'i dbang rdo rje 'phreng ba sogs la/ rgyud sde tha dad du ma phye bar gcig shes kun grol du bskur ba'i lugs dang*/ rgyud sde so sor phyes te tha dad kyi lugs bzhin bskur ba ste/ de ltar phyag bzhes so sor yod pa bzhin/ rnying ma'i theg pa rim dgu'i dbang 'di dag la yang*/ bla med kyi dkyil 'khor chen po gcig gi steng nas gzhan rnams yongs rdzogs su bskur thabs dang*/ rgyud sde 177)so sor dkyil 'khor zhal phyes te tha dad kyi lugs ltar bskur ba ste/ phyag bzhes gnyis ldan du yod cing*/ gang ltar yang yo ga rnam gsum gyi rgyud sde du ma'i dgongs pa ji lta bar/ pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs rig 'dzin paṇa grub dam pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes dri ma med pa ma gtogs/ rnying rul gyi sngags gzugs bu smad pha rgan dag gis rang bzo'i rdzun chos su byas pa ni ma yin no/ zhes skabs kyi 'phros don du glengs pa'o// de nas gong gi 'phror de ltar dbang gi dbye ba bzhi kho nar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni de bzhi'i dgos byed gang yin zhe na/ sbyang gzhi/ sbyang bya/ sbyong byed/ sbyang 'bras rnams kyi sgo nas ston te/ de yang 'gro ba'i phung khams snod bcud rnams bum dbang gi sbyang gzhi yin la/ ngag rlung dang yi ger gnas pa ni gsang dbang gi sbyang gzhi dang*/ khams thig 178)le bde chen du gnas pa sher dbang gi dang*/ sems nyid ye nas chos skur gnas pa tshig dbang gi ste/ de ltar rgyu'i gzhi rang la lhun grub tu bzhi po der gnas pa'i phyir dang*/

'o na de dag ye nas rang la lhun gyis grub par yod na dbang bzhi po bskur ga la dgos snyam na/ rgyu'am/ sa bon nam/ gzhi de ltar gnas pa de dag sgrib par byed pa'i 'khrul pa'i bag chags sbyang bya bzhi yod de/ lus snod bcud tha mal a 'thas su 'dzin pa'i 'khrul pa dang*/ ngag tha mal du 'dzin pa dang*/ yid tha mal 'khrul 'dzin dang*/ sgo gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i bag chags rnams te/ de bzhi sbyong byed ni dbang bzhir rag lus pa'i phyir dang*/ de la yang spang bya'i 'dod chags bzhi ste/ lta rgod/ lag bcangs/ 'khyud pa ste bzhi spong ba dang*/ sgrub byed phyag rgya bzhi ste/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ 179)chos kyi phyag rgya/ las kyi phyag rgya/ phyag rgya chen po dang bzhi mngon du byed pa*/ nyams dga' ba bzhi ste/ dga' ba'i ye shes/ mchog dga'i ye shes/ dga' bral gyi ye shes/ lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes dang bzhi nyams su myong ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor bzhi ste/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ yab yum lus dkyil/ gsang ba'i pad+ma/ rang rig ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang bzhi bskur zhing thob pa dang*/ nyams len bzhis/ lha'i bskyed rim/ rtsa rlung dang bzlas brjod/ thig le'i myur lam/ phyag rdzogs kyi grol lam rnams nyams su len par dbang zhing las su rung ba/ rtogs bya'i lta ba bzhi ste/ sems tsam/ dbu ma gsang sngags phyag rdzogs rnams kyi lta ba rtogs par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'bras bu sku bzhi ste/ sprul sku/ longs sku/ chos sku/ ngo bo nyid sku rnams 'grub par 'gyur ba dang*/ gzhan don phrin las bzhi 180)ste/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ dbang*/ drag po'i phrin las la mnga' brnyes pa sogs/ de ltar dbang bzhi po'i dgos ched dang skabs don ni de dag tu 'du lags/ phan yon gyi dgos pa ni bsam gyi mi khyab ste/ ji skad du/ mkha' 'gro gsang mdzod las/ ma smin smin byed dbang rnams legs thob skyes bus dam tshig la gnas na// des ni gnas skabs dngos grub kun 'grub mthar thug 'bras bu sku gsum thob par 'gyur/

zhes sogs rgyud sde rnams las brjod kyi mi lang bar gsungs pa dang*/ dbang srog ni dam tshig la 'dus phyir/ de'i rim pa yang rgyas par ni gong du bshad pa'i theg pa rim dgu yongs rdzogs kyi dbang gi skabs tshor ni mdo sngags gnyis ka'i bslab sdom gyi rnam grangs mtha' dag dang*/ gzhan sngags lugs 'ba' shig la'ang gsar rnying gnyis tha dad ltar na/ gsar ma'i lugs la rgyud sde bzhi so so'i rtsa ltung gi grangs nges dus 'khor sogs nas gsungs pa rnams dang*/ 181)bla med spyi la ni brtul zhugs nyer lnga/ rigs lnga'i dam tshig rtsa ltung bzhi/ yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad sogs gsungs pa thams cad dang*/ rnying lugs ltar na/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la phyi nang gsang ba gsum gsum du phye bas nyi shu rtsa bdun/ yan lag gi dam tshig nyer lnga/ phra mor bdag don nyer gcig dang*/ gzhan don zhe bzhi sogs dang*/ rang bzhin lta ba'i dam tshig chen po bzhi rnams kyang gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i khyad par gyi dam tshig ste/ mdor na/ bka' gsar rnying gi rgyud 'grel rnams las gsungs pa thams cad ma nyams par tshul bzhin bsrung dgos mod kyi/ khyad par 'di skabs su dbang bzhi so so'i mnyam rjes bza' bcang bsrung ba'i dam tshig rnams dmigs gsal du brjod na/ bum dbang thob nas 182)de'i mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig tu bskyed rim bsgom pa/ rjes thob kyi dam tshig tu sgo gsum tha mal du mi 'khrul bar/ lha'i 'du shes dang ma bral ba/ bza' ba'i dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la longs spyod pa/ bcang ba'i dam tshig tu rdor dril mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'chang ba/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig tu snod bcud lha'i dkyil 'khor du blta zhing log lta spong ba rnams ma nyams par bya ba dang*/ de bzhin du/ gsang dbang gi mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig gtum mo bsgom pa/ rjes thob kyi dam tshig a thung gi me ma brjed pa/ bza' ba'i dam tshig bza' btung thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byinabarlabs te rol ba/

bcang ba'i dam tshig zhag rer rlung kha sbyor nyer gcig sogs ma chag pa/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig khams byang sems ma nyams pa rnams dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob nas mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig dngos sam yid kyi phyag rgya bsten pa/ rjes thob 183)kyi dam tshig bde chen gyi nyams dang mi 'bral ba/ bza' ba'i dam tshig snyom 'jug gi tshul du rol ba/ bcang ba'i dam tshig kun+da byang sems la gces spras bya ba/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig shes rab rang bzhin mo rigs la log lta spong ba dang*/ dbyer med bde chen tshig dbang rin po che'i mnyam bzhag dam tshig zung 'jug blo 'das kyi don bsgom pa/ rjes thob yengs 'khrul du ma shor bar zung 'jug gi nyams dang ma bral ba/ bza' ba'i dam tshig chos nyid la chos nyid rol ba/ bcang ba'i dam tshig dus rtag tu lta sgom gyi gnad las ma g.yos par bya ba dang*/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig gang shar la dgag sgrub zhen 'dzin gyis mi bslad pa ste/ de ltar dbang bzhi lam du khyer ba'i dam tshig 'di dag skad cig kyang ma nyams par bsrung na/ gsang sngags kyi yon tan thams cad yongs rdzogs su rang gi rgyud la spungs pa ltar 'byung bas/ myur du sku bzhi'i 184)'bras bu mngon du 'gyur bar gdon mi za ba dang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan mtha' dag 'bad med lhun grub chen por 'byung bar gsungs so/ de ltar 'di yan chad kyi dbang bzhi'i spyi bshad brda tshon 'di dag sku nyid lta bu ni chos kyi mdzod la mnga' dbang 'byor tshe tshul 'di dag snyan du gsol ba ni spyan ras gzigs la yig drug slob pa'i dpe ltar 'gyur bar zad la/ chos lugs gzhan gyi gang zag mkhas grub rnams ni rmongs pa bdag 'dra'i blun tshig yig 'khyar 'di dag la dgongs pa gtad mkhan ga nas 'ong tshe rang nyid yi ge'i las su che mod kyi/ 'on kyang rang phyogs kyi grwa slob tu ming btags pa'i ser gzugs sngags lam du zhugs par khas che yang sngags kyi chos tshul sho lo ka gcig gi go gzhi yang ma 'jags pa rnams gti mug gi gnyid las slong rkyen tsam du gyur na ci ma rung bsam

185)nas skabs 'dir bris pa lags/ da ni khyad par du/ sku nyid kyi don dam pa'i dbang gi thob mtshams kyi dri ba dang*/ zhar la dbang gsum par snyad btags nas bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren pa rnams kyi snang tshul dang bcas pa zhib rgyas su bstsal ba'i lan du/ rang nyid kyis ji ltar go tshul 'gag bsdus su 'bul te/ de yang spyir bstan pa rin po che dang khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs par 'dod pa'i gang zag snying thag pa nas byang chub thob 'dod kyi nges 'byung gi bsam pa dang ldan pa zhig gis/ bla ma'i zol dang bdud kyi bslu mkhan ma yin par/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan ldan zhig la/ g.yo zol med pa'i gus pa dang*/ sangs rgyas su thag chod pa'i dad pas btugs te/ bla mas kyang brnyed bkur la lta ba sogs ma yin pa'i lhag bsam 186)gyis rjes su bzung nas blo rigs dang mthun par lam du khrid cing*/ snod du rung zhing dus la babs pa na/ thog mar bum dbang la dkyil 'khor dang cho ga'i las rim sogs rgyas kyang rung bsdus kyang rung ste/ gtso bor slob ma de nyid snod bcud phyi nang phra rags kun la tha mal a 'thas kyi bag chags 'khrul zhen 'di zhi thub pa'i thabs kho na nan tan du byas te bum dbang bskur zhing ngo sprad/ slob ma de yang kha tsam tshig tsam min par bla mas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin snod bcud phung khams skye mched kyi bsdus pa'i brtan g.yo'i dngos po mtha' dag lha'i dkyil 'khor 'ba' zhig ye gdod ma nas kyang yin la/ da lta yang bla ma dang gdams ngag gi drin las blo bur 'khrul pa'i sgrib byed sangs te/ phyi snod gzhal yas dang nang bcud lha'i dkyil 'khor yin pa'i yin tshul go zhing*/ khyad par 187)du rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur bas/ phung po lnga rigs lnga/ 'byung ba lnga yum lnga/ dug lnga ye shes lnga sogs bzod ma nas rang la rang chas su gnas tshul ji lta bar shes shing rtogs pa la bum dbang thob pa zhes bya ba ste/

bum dbang gi dbang don ni der 'dus te/ don du phyi nang snod bcud kun la tha mal a 'thas kyi las snang dag thub pa zhig dgos tshe/ de'i thabs dang rten 'brel la dgongs nas/ dbang chog rnams las ye shes dbab pa'i skabs sogs su/ gzugs tha mal gyi zhen rtog dgag pa'i phyir mig dar bcings/ sgra tha mal gyi zhen rtog dgag phyir rol mo sgrag dri tha mal pa dgag phyir spos dang gu gul sogs ye shes 'bebs pa'i rdzas sbyor gyi du bas bdug ro'i 'dzin rtog dgag phyir byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsis khyor ba bkang*/ reg bya'i 'dzin 188)rtog dgag phyir lus rnam snang chos bdun nam/ rdo rje'i 'dug stangs sogs kyi 'khrul 'khor bca'/ yid kyi 'khrul zhen dgag pa'i phyir ting 'dzin dmigs pa'i spro bsdu rnams gsal btab cing*/ slob dpon gyis kyang ting 'dzin brtan pos byin dbab pa'i mthus/ slob ma'i sgo gsum tha lam 'khrul pa'i snang ba 'di dar cig 'gags nas/ rab la rang byung lhan skyes kyi ye shes sgrib bral du 'char/ 'bring dag snang mos gus gdung shugs bzod med du skye zhing nyams 'bar ba'i rnam 'gyur ston/ tha ma rnams kyang snang ba zil bun ne ba tsam 'byung thub pa zhig nges par dgos pas na/ de ltar ting nge 'dzin dang thabs kyi bye brag de lta bus slob ma'i rgyud la dbang don gyi ye shes bskyed cing*/ bskyed pa de nyid ngo sprad nas brtan par bya phyir dbang rgyas btab ste/ de don las mi 'da' bar byed pa yin 189)la/ de skabs dbang don ji lta ba rgyud la skyes na/ kun rdzob kyi dbang rdzas rnams mgor bzhag kyang rung ma bzhag kyang rung ste/ don gyi dbang legs par thob pa yin pa dang*/ bum dbang gi don de bzhin rtogs na/ de'i grol lam bskyed rim yang kun brtags blos byas kyi bskyed sgom la ma ltos shing dbyibs dang kha dog la lhar 'dzin pa'i bzang zhen las grol te/

snang srid dag par rab 'byams su ngang gi shar bas/ bdag gzhan/ dgra gnyen/ legs nyes sogs kyi chags sdang thams cad rang sar grol ba zhig 'byung mod kyi/ dbang don 'di bzhin ma shes phyin chad/ dkyil 'khor gyis yul khams khengs par bshams nas/ bum sogs kyi dbang rdzas khri 'bum mang po mgor bzhag cing*/ bum chus 'khyer thub pa tsam du sbyin yang*/ slob ma'i rgyud ni sngar tha mal pa'i 'jig rten 190)gyi 'khrul 'dzin gra ma nyams pa de kar lus pa las 'os med cing*/ bum dbang tsam gyi dbang don rgyud la ma skyes na/ dbang gong ma rnams bskur ba'i yul du yang mi rung zhing slar yang mi gshis de lta bu dag la smin byed kyi sa bon ma thebs par grol byed kyi lo 'bras 'byung rgyu ga la 'ong tshe/ dpon slob gnyis ka don med kyi las su zad la/ stabs nyes na gsang sngags gsang sgrog gi nyes ltung dang bka' chad kyi rgyu rkyen las ma mchis pa'o/ de bas na de lta bu ma yin pas/ dpon slob snod bcud kyi rten 'brel 'dzom pas/ bum dbang gi lus smin te phung po dang rtsa khams dag cing dug lnga ye shes su shar ba'i mthus/ gsang dbang gi snod du rung bar gyur pa de la/ bla ma yab yum gyi lus dkyil la brten nas gsang rdzas lce la bzhag 191)cing dbang don ngo sprad pas/ ngag tha mal gyi 'khrul zhen dag nas/ gsung rdo rje lhun grub tu ye nas yin tshul rtogs tshe/ sgra grags mtha' dag sngags kyi 'khor lor shes shing*/ bzlas brjod spro bsdu dang*/ rdor bzlas 'gog bzlas sogs gang la'ang rang dbang thob/ gtum mo 'bar 'dzag thig le zhu btul dbab bskyil bzlog dgram la goms pa mngon du gyur pas sher dbang gi snod rung du gyur pa de la/ dngos bsam yid kyi phyag rgya la brten nas dga' bzhi mngon sum du 'char zhing nyams su myong du bcug la bde stong lhan skyes ye shes ngo sprad pas/ des mtshon nas bde sdug tsha grang 'jam rtsub dga' mi dga' chags sdang la sogs sems kyi rtog tshogs mtha' dag kyang lhan skyes ye shes su ro gcig par rtogs nas dbang gsum pa'i don ji bzhin rgyud la skyes pas/

yid thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo yin 192)pa'i yin lugs rig tshe tshig dbang gi snod rung du gyur pa de la/ dbang thams cad kyi rgyal po bde ba chen po'i dbang ngam/ tshig dbang rin po che'am rdzogs chen rnams su ni rig pa'i rtsal dbang zhes pa'i ming du brjod pa de nyid tshul bzhin ngo sprad pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sku bzhi dbyer med du ye shes rdo rje rang rig gnyug ma ma bcos lhun grub khyab gdal chen por ngo shes/ thag chod la bzlas te gzhi lam 'bras gsum/ lta sgom spyod gsum sogs mdor na chos sgo brgyad khri stong thams cad kyi gnad don rjen pa da lta'i tha mal gyis shes pa'i thog tu hril gyi 'dus pa'i don mngon sum bde blag tu rtogs nas/ re dogs gnyis 'dzin dgag sgrub kyi yul las 'das shing*/ gang shar ye shes kyi rnam rol du btsan sa zin par 'gyur ba ste/ de ltar dbang bzhi tshul ldan du bskur 193)zhing thob pa'i tshul ni de 'dra zhig dgos par snang la/ rnying lugs rdzogs chen rnams las ni/ dbang bzhi po 'di dag re re la lo zla'i bar du bcad de bskur zhing dbang don nyams su len lugs dang*/ de ltar byas pas dbang bzhi rdzogs pa dang slob ma de grub thob tu gyur pa dus mnyam du 'byung bar gsungs mod kyang*/ ding sang ni gsar rnying gi gang zag rnams la ni ci zhu/ gzhan phal che ba rnams ni gsang sngags kyi chos rnams lto phyir dang rnyed tshol gyi zong du byed de/ dang po nas sngags kyi gzhung tshig rnams kha khyer dang spros bcas kyi lag len bsgrigs rim tsam zhig lobs na des chog par brtsi zhing*/ smin grol dang bskyed rdzogs kyi don dgos gal che ba rnams ni rna ba'i lam du thos kyang ma myong bzhin du/ ltar snang du skad dang gdangs dbyangs rol 194)mo sogs gang bzanga'agran zhing*/ sbyin bdag rnams kyi sar 'gro sa gang rnyed du phyin te/

bsngos sha dang chang la gtso bor byas pa'i bza' btung yon dang bcas pa kho na don du gnyer ba 'ba' zhig gi dus 'da' ba dang*/ bdag 'dra ba bla ma'i ming du btags pa rnams kyang rang gi rgyud la skyabs 'gro tsam gyi don ji bzhin shes pa'ang med rung*/ skye bo mgu byed kyi cha lugs dang spyod tshul bcos ma byi la'i brtul zhugs lta bu la brten zhing*/ zang zing yong sgo 'ba' shig snying khongs su bcangs nas/ chos bshad/ dbang bskur/ khrid 'debs/ sdom pa 'bogs/ rab gnas dang gshin don la sogs te/ mdor na rdo rje slob dpon byed pa'i nus pa ci yang med bzhin rnyed 'tshol kho na'i ched du/ pho bzo dang spobs pas kun nas blangs te mi byed pa'i sna med pa gcig byas pa'i 'bras bu zas 195) nor cung zad rnyed pa dag gnas min gyi phyogs su zad par byed pas mi tshe 'da' zhing*/ rang 'khor 'brel thogs dang bcas pa kun phung la sbyor ba dang*/ la la dag rang la yig drug 'phreng bskor re tsam bgrangs pa'i yon tan dang nus pa ya med bzhin du/ skyes chen dam pa de lta bu'i skye sprul lam gdung rgyud khyad par can yin pas/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin shes pas chog 'brel tshad don ldan yin no zhes bsgrags te/ sngon gyi gtam rgyud du bong sha 'tshong phyir ri dwags kyi rnga ma ston pa'i lo rgyus sam/ ba la 'o ma med par dril bu btags nas 'tshong ba'i dpe ltar byed mkhan mang po dang*/ lar gzhan yang rgya gar du dgra bcom dang paṇa grub kun gyis ni/ khyim pa sogs skye bo phal ba rnams la las 'bras dang*/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi dang rten 'brel 'byung ldog 196)dang*/ sbyin pa'i gtam la sogs pa'i chos kyis tshim par mdzad tshul ma gtogs/ 'o skol bod kyi ltar dbang bskur sogs byas pa'i lo rgyus gang las kyang ma byung mod kyi/ ding sang bod khams kong sogs 'di dag tu ni/ dge bskul dang 'gro don yin zer nas/

skye bo tha mal yi ge tsam yang mi shes pa gang byung byung la dbang sbyin dang khrom dbang sogs byed phyir/ rnga brdung*/ dung 'bud/ 'cham bro sogs rtsed sna du ma dang*/ mi chos dang thabs ka'i yo lang sogs thabs dang g.yo zol sna tshogs kyi sgo nas skye bo bsdus te/ dbang chos zong du btsongs nas 'bul bsdud dang zas nor bsgrub pa la brtson pa 'di lta bur dar zhing*/ skye bo rnams ni dbang gi snod du rung mi rung dang dbang don gyi ye shes sogs ni lta zhog ltad mo dang zla grogs kyi rtsed mo'i zhor phyir dbang zhu bar byed pa mang la/ la la dag cung zad dad pa'am 197)chos nyams yod par rlom pa rnams kyang*/ rang gi nad gdon sel phyir ram/ skag dang mo lung rtsis lung khegs pa'i slad du dbang zhu bar byed cing*/ der yang bla ma des dbang gi bshad pa sogs byas kyang ma byas kyang*/ zhu ba sapa rnams ni snod kyi skyon gsum dri ma drug gi 'thums pas don ni ci yang ma go dbang rdzas mgo la btugs pa tsam re byed pa de dbang yin no snyam pa las/ dbang gral gyis dus bla ma des 'di lta bu zhig ngo sprad byung bsam pa ni tshig gcig kyang nyams snang la ma 'khor bar ham sang nge log 'gro ba 'di lta bu'i dbang bskur dar mod la/ yang 'ga' zhig gi bzhed kyi/ phal pa la khrom dbang sogs byed pa rnams sngags kyi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs min zhing*/ rig gtad rjes gnang sogs yin pas skyon med do/ zer yang*/ rig gtad sogs yin bzhin 198) du de thob nas ni lha de nyid yid du bzung ste bsnyen bsgrub sogs byed dgos pa'i dam tshig dang*/ der ma zad/ de skabs su skyabs sems dang rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba sogs kyi rjes bzlos byed dgos tshe/ khrom dang skye bo phal pa dag la de 'dra'i spang blang nyams len sogs kyi tha snyad ga la 'byung tshe/ des na 'di 'dra ba'i phyag srol mang po zhig rang gzhan kun gyi byed mod/

lar dam pa'i chos btsongs nas za ba rnams lcags kyi tho lum me 'bar ba za zhing khro chu khol ma khong du 'thung ba'i dmyal bar skye ba ru mdo las gsungs na/ da lta'i chos pa rnams snying stobs nan ltar che par snang la/ yong gong du smos pa'i dpon slob kyi 'brel tshul de dag las cung drag par mdzad bzhed pa rnams kyang*/ dbang bskur byed pa'i tshe/ gsar ma ba rnams ni chog khrigs sogs las rim mtha' dag gzhung 199)nas bshad pa bzhin dgos pa yin gsungs nas/ bdag 'jug sogs las rim kho na la nan tan mdzad/ rnying ma rnams ni byin rlabs sngags la rag las pa yin gsungs nas 'dzab bsnyen la gtso bor mdzad pa'i phyag srol 'dug rung*/ rang nyid kyi blun tshod la ni/ de thams cad 'dzom dgos pa yang gzhir bcas te/ khyad par du ni/ bla ma'i byin rlabs dang slob ma'i mos gus 'dzom pa'i mthu la brten te byin rlabs zhugs shing dbang don ngo phrod pa kho na gal che bar go zhing*/ de lta bu'i byin rlabs shig zhugs na gnas skabs kyi rdzas dbang 'di lta bu bskur ma bskur gcig pu la ma rag par snang ste/ dper na/ til+li pas na ro la ras yug me stag gi bsreg pa sogs kyi brda bcu gnyis bstan pa'i mthus dbang bzhi'i don mngon du mdzad 200)tshul dang*/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes sam/ nyi zla dngos grub ces kyang bya ba/ gcod yul rgyud pa'i skabs su ni su kha sidhir grags shing*/ rnying lugs su ni mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang chen zhes grags pa des/ gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la dbang bskur tshe/ gu ru nyid yi ge hūm̐ zhig tu bsgyur nas mkha' 'gros zhal du bzhes/ sku'i dbyibs rgyud/ gsang ba'i pad+mor phyungs pas dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs su thob ste phyag rgya chen po mchog gi grub pa brnyes tshul dang*/ gu ru nyid bod yul nas lho nub tu gshegs khar bsam yas has po'i rir lha sras rje 'bangs lnga la zab chos pad+ma snying tig gnang tshe/

skad cig la gnas de nyid bde ba can gyi zhing khams su sprul nas/ 'od zer spro bsdu'i dbang gnang bas smin par mdzad tshul sogs dang*/ gzhan yang*/ mnga' bdag mai tri pas dpal sha wa ri dbang phyug lus srog 201)dang brdos nas btsal zhing 'jal ba'i tshe phyag spyi bor bzhag pa tsam gyis rgyud smin grol du gyur tshul dang*/ grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor la mkha' 'gro ne dgu mas gsang chab ka pā la gang blud cing sdigs 'dzub snying khar gtad pas dbang don mngon du gyur pa dang*/ grub thob o rgyan pa la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma smad 'tshong ma'i gzugs kyis thug pa phor gang sbyin pas dbang don rtogs pa dang*/ gter gton gu ru chos dbang gis bal po bha ro gtsug 'dzin la dri chen spyi bor bzhag dri chu kha ru blud pas zag med lhan skyes ye shes la zhag bdun du gnas shing grol ba'i lo rgyus dang*/ mkhas grub skyo shas ston pas ma gcig lab kyi sgron ma dbang gral nas bton te brdung zhing drud de chu nang du phul brdeg byas pa las dbang gi 202)ye shes mngon du gyur nas brtsigs pa la zangs thal du byon tshul dang*/ zhi byed rgyud pa'i dam pa sgom smon gyi 'chus pa dar brtson la ja phor pa gang dang phye rkyal pa zhig gnang nas dbang bskur gyi dod po yin gsungs pas bla ma dang rtogs pa mnyam pa'i byin rlabs zhugs tshul sogs/ 'di 'dra ba'i lo rgyus brjod las 'das pa 'byung phyir/ dbang gi gtso bo ni byin rlabs zhugs te ye shes rgyud la shar ba zhig gal che bar snang ngo*/ des na ding sang gi skabs su ni rgyud nas gsungs pa'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ slob dpon slob ma'i mtshan nyid sogs tshang mi tshang dang*/ slob ma grangs nges dgos mi dgos sogs kyi skabs don ni brjod pa'i don yang ma mchis pa 'di 'dra dang*/ dbang don dang de'i lam nyams su len tshul dang*/ dam tshig gi rim pa sogs thams cad dpe cha'i logs la

203)lus shing*/ dpon slob thams cad gang dga' gang skyid longs spyod gang che byas chog pa 'di 'dra'i dus na/ 'o skol gnyis kyi dbang gi gsungs gleng 'di dag gzhan gyi thugs la zug ngu slong rkyen las spros pa zhig mi yong bar gda' lags te/ gang ltar dgos don la/ bum dbang thob pas phung khams lhar smin cing bskyed rim gyi brda don tshul bzhin shes nas nyams su blangs pas sprul sku'i sa bon thebs/ gsang dbang thob nas rlung 'byin 'jug gnas gsum sogs sngags su rtogs shing nyams su blangs pas longs sku'i sa bon thebs/ sher dbang thob nas yid kyi byung tshor rtog tshogs chos nyid du shar zhing lhan skyes ye shes bskyangs pas chos sku'i sa bon thebs/ tshig dbang thos pas 'khor 'das mnyam nyid du thag chod de zung 'jug blo 'das kyi ngang 204)las ma g.yos bar nyams len chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bskyangs pas/ dbyer med ngo bo nyid sku'i go 'phang rab tshe 'di 'bring bar do sogs su 'grub cing*/ smon lam thugs rje'i sprul pas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don rtsol med lhun grub chen por 'byung ba nyid do/ de yang*/ khyad par dbang gsum pa'i skabs don zur gsal du 'bul ba ni/ de yang 'di skabs/ nyid kyis thabs shes dang snang stong sogs kyi lung don dang*/ sems nyid spros bral ni rdo rje phag mo'i shes rab phar phyin sogs bzod ma nas lhun gyis grub phyir gnas skabs gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba sogs la ltos mi ltos kyi dri ba gnang ba'i cha la/ spyir dbang bzhi ga'i rgyu'am sa bon rang rgyud la rdo rje bzhi'i ngo bor bzhugs tshul gong du bshad pa ltar dang*/ de'i phyir sa lugs lam 'bras gsum 205)gyi dbang gi rnam dbye mdzad pa'i don yang 'di yin mod cing*/ rgyu'am gzhi rang la yod kyang lhan skyes kyi sgrib pas bsgribs nas rang zhal rang gis ma mthong ba de la/ bla mas smin grol gnyis kyi sgo nas ngo sprad pas rang byung gi ye shes rang gsal du byed pa yin phyir/

dbang gsum pa'i bskur thob kyang*/ sngags kyi dbang gzhung phal cher du ni 'dod khams pa'i sems can la nyon mongs pa kun gyi nang nas 'dod chags 'ba' zhig shas che bas/ 'di thabs kyi lam du ma lhongs na 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin phyir/ nyan thos kyi theg pa sogs su spong ba lam byed kyi rgyu'i gtso bor gsungs pa yin la/ dbang rnon sngags kyi lam zhugs rnams la ni/ ji skad du/ ji ltar me yis tshig pa'i rma// me nyid la ni sro bar bya// ji ltar rna bar 206)chu zhugs pa// chu gzhan gyis ni dgug par bya/ zhes pa dper mdzad nas/ 'dod chags nyid kyi 'dod chags dag ces gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ltar chags lam gyi gdams pa zab mo ji snyed pa rgyud sde dang gsar rnying gi man ngag rnams las 'byung mod kyi/ dam tshig nyams len gyi snod dang skal ba can dag la dgongs te/ gsum pa'i dbang gi bskur thabs kyang rgyas par gsungs pas na/ gang zhig lam der zhugs 'dod thun mong ma yin pa dag gis ni/ dang por bla ma yang lam 'di nyid mngon gyur nges zhig la bsten te/ bum dbang gi lus sbyangs pa rab tu gyur rjes gsang dbang gi lag len tshul bzhin gtan la phabs nas thob nges su byas la rtsa rlung khams gsum gyi nus pa rtags thon dang rang lus kyi yon tan mthar phyin tshe sher dbang zhus te/ yas brtan dang mas brtan gyi dga' 207)bzhi ngo 'phrod de lhan skyes ye shes la dbang thob pa zhig la ni tshig dbang rin po che yang bskur las sla bar 'byung mod kyi/ 'di skabs kyi dpe dang don gyi ye shes ngos 'dzin tshul la nā ro mai tri gnyis kyang bzhed pa tha dad dang*/ bod du yang sa kar gnyis dgag sgrub mdzad tshul sogs mchis mod kyi/ rang gi go tshul ni/ skabs 'dir snyom 'jug gi bde ba'i ye shes kyi mtshan nas/ tshor ba mtha' dag lhan skyes ye shes su ro snyoms pa zhig dgos par sems te/ de ltar ma rtogs na bde ba lhan skyes su shar ba yang sdug bsngal dang na tsha sogs lhan skyes su mi 'char/

de ma shar na rtog tshogs thams cad chos nyid du ngo sprod thabs mi 'byung bas/ dbang gsum pa'i dgos pa stor bar 'gyur zhing*/ gsum pa'i don ma shar na bzhi pa yang ga la thob ste/ des na cir 208)snang ci shar thams cad lhan skyes ye shes su smin pa zhig dgos pa dang*/ de ltar gyur tshe snyom 'jug gi bde ba'i nyams len gcig bu la ltos mi dgos pa/ snang ba yab la stong pa yum sogs kyi tshig don mthun pa 'gro zhing*/ de yang na/ zhang rin po che thabs lam gyi nyams rtogs mthar son pas/ zhabs la tsher ma zug pa'am/ dbu brag phug la thug pa sogs thams cad bde stong lhan skyes su shar tshul gyi lo rgyus lta bur dgos par go la/ de'i phyir/ nā ro pa dka' chen bcu gnyis spyad pa'i nang tshan gyi/ te lo pas gsang rdor rdo bas brdungs pa'i tshul gyi dgongs don yang 'dir gda' mod/ des na chags lam pa tshul ldan zhig yin na/ byang sems dkyil bzlog 'gram pa la rang dbang thob dgos pa yang smos ci dgos te/ rlung nus sogs kyi de tsam nus 209)pa ni sla mod kyang*/ de las khag che ba 'dod chags sor rtogs ye shes su byed nus pa zhig kho na ma byung na thab lam par mi 'gro zhing*/ mdo sngags gnyis ka'i rtsa ltung bsgrub par 'gyur na'ang*/ ding sang ni nyid kyi gsungs bzhin mdo sngags gnyis ka dang*/ 'jig rten gyi tshul lugs thams cad dang 'gal ba'i spyod/ rtsings pa mang pos shākya'i bstan la rma 'byin cing*/ khyad par 'ga' zhig gis rlung nus cung zad tsam thob nas rgyab thur mdun thur dang rdo rje chu 'thung sogs skye bo mang po'i khrod du ltad mo ston rgyur byed pa thos pas/ de dag na rang nyid dang bla ma dang chos dang bcas pa thams cad chu bor 'phangs par ma zad/ gsang sngags ces pa'i ming nyid kyang thal ba'i rdul du rlag par byas pa nyid du zad do/ lar yang*/ dbang gsum pa'i nyams len ji lta ba tshul bzhin

210)rgyud la khel na/ byang sems 'bab pa'i rtsa so gnyis dwangs pas sangs rgyas kyi mtshan so gnyis 'grub pa dang*/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog tshogs dag pas dpe byad brgyad bcu dang*/ gsang rdor sbubs su nus pas gtsug tor dang*/ gdos bcas dag pas 'ja' lus sogs mdor na kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan 'grub tshul dag gsar rnying gi rgyud lung man ngag rnams su rgyas par 'byung zhing*/ tel+lo nā ro bir wa pa sogs grub thob phal cher yang dang por 'dul 'dzin gyi paṇa chen mdzad cing*/ mthar lam 'di dag gi sgo nas grub pa rnyes tshul dang*/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha yang paṇa chen lnga brgya'i mkhan po mdzad rjes mda' mkhan mo phyag rgyar bzhes nas/ kha sang phan chad dge slong min/ de ring tshun chod dge slong yin/ zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ rnying ma'i yang*/ gu ru rin po che 211)nyid kyis gtso mdzad pa'i rig 'dzin grub thob thams cad lam zab 'di ltar bu la brten nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa mtha' yas mod kyang*/ snyigs dus yang mtha'i skabs 'di 'dra'i gang zag rnams kyi/ 'dul 'dzin par rlom pa rnams ni/ bslab gzhi phra mo dag brtson btson ltar byed kyang sdom pa'i rtsa ba gal can rnams kyi spang blang ni go log kho na bsgrub pa dang*/ sngags lam pa yin par khas 'che ba rnams ni 'jig rten skye bo phal pa las brgya 'gyur gyis lod pa'i spyod pa 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' ba ma gtogs/ mdo sngags tha dad dang zung 'jug gang gi tshul mthun pa zhig ni phyogs gang du yang u dum wā ra'i me tog ltar dkon na'ang log 'tsho lnga la hab thob byed mkhan gyi chos gzugs zol ma ni grog tshang kha phyes pa ltar snang tshe/ yid kyi khye'u skyo ba'i mal 212)du nyal ba las gzhan pa'i thabs dang bral bar gyur to/ yang*/ 'o na gsang sngags dbang gsum pa 'di zhu bde lhan skyes kho na la brten pa ma gtogs gzhan bskur thabs med pa yin nam zhe na ma yin te/

gsang sngags ni thabs zab pa/ thabs mang ba/ thabs myur ba/ thabs rgya che ba yin tshe/ dbang gsum pa'i brda thabs kyang rigs mang zhing*/ gsar ma'i dbang mchog mang por me long sin+du+u ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa sogs dang*/ de bzhin rnying lugs la'ang thabs kyi bye brag mang ste/ zhu bde lhan skyes la brten pa'i brda thabs kyang*/ bye brag gzungs ma'i gzugs kyi tsakli'am/ dril bu'am/ chos 'byung sogs la brten nas bskur thabs dang*/ yang*/ kun rdzob byang sems dang bde stong la mi brten par don dam byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor la brten zhing*/ shel dang me long sogs kyi dbang rdzas 213)la brten nas ngo sprad pas gsal stong ngam/ rig stong zung 'jug gi ye shes la mngon sum mdzub tshugs su ngo sprad pa'i thabs kyi rim pa yang du ma 'byung ba dang*/ de dag gi yan lag tu gzugs legs mi legs gnyis bshibs te bltar bcug nas gnyis med du ngo sprad/ de bzhin sgra snyan mi snyan so sor bsgrag pa dang*/ spos dang sha rul gyi dri sogs dang*/ bu ram dang mkhris pa sogs kyi ro dang*/ dar dang re tshal gyi reg bya so sor lus la drud nas ngo sprod 'debs pa sogs rgya cher yod mod la/ khyad par dbang gzhung phal cher du ni dbang gong ma thams cad la mtshan bcas kyi dbang rdzas mi dgos pa mang zhing*/ gzhan yang gtor ma tsam la brten nas dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs bskur thabs sogs kyang bsam las 'das phyir/ don dam par ni/ gong du yang yang smos pa 214)ltar/ byin rlabs kyi ye shes 'char thub pa zhig gal che bas na/ dbang gsum pa yang bskur tshul tsam gang la brten kyang dgos don ni yid sgrib dag cing rtog tshogs chos nyid du shar te chos sku'i sa bon thebs pa nyid lags mod de/ ji skad du/ zhi byed kyi rgyud las/ brjod bral lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyid// tshogs bsags sgrib pa dag pa'i lag rjes dang*// rtogs ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na las// thabs gzhan brten na rmongs par shes par bya/

zhes gsungs pa nyid do/ des na ding sang gi smin grol gyi lam ston pa po phal cher gyi rnam thar ni/ rje karma pa brgyad pa'i gsungs las/ ri khrod dben pa'i shes pa yengs su bcug /mtshur phu pa yi lag len 'khrul med tsam// mi shes bzhin du nag po chen po yi// gtor ma 'bul ba tsam zhig byed pa la// rdo rje 'dzin par rlom pa smyon pa 215)dngos// ma ṇi tsam zhig kha bton byed na yang*// rgyud sde bzhi po gang gi cho ga dang*// mthun par ma gyur bzlas kyang phan yon chung*/ zhes sogs dang*/ zan shos re tsam mgo la bzhag byas nas// sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs shig ces// de 'dra dbang bskur nyid du rlom pa mang*/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin sha stag dang*/ gzhan yang spyod pa ci dgar byed pa la brtul zhugs su ming btags pa dang*/ zang zing 'tshol thabs la 'gro don du ming 'dogs pa dang*/ za thabs la tshogs 'khor du ming 'dogs pa sogs mang ste/ grub thob o rgyan pas/ bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad dang ma ldan par// sha chang spyod pa'i tshogs mkhan tsho// yi dwags kyi sa bon ma btabs sam/ zhes pa ltar dang*/ lar yang o rgyan rin po ches lung ji ltar bstan pa rnams 216)mngon du gyur pa ste/ lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ 'dul ba'i bstan pa nyams pa'i dngos rtags su// khrims 'chal dge slong sngags kyi chos su brdzu// chos gos rnam gsum tshad 'chugs rig bzo dar// sha chang lkog za dus min kha zas len// bslab pa'i gral 'chugs gos tshos rgyan la bzabs// dge 'dun sdom med gri mtshon rgyan du byed// gnas bstan mkhan slob 'khrug dpon byed pa 'byung*// shākya'i bstan pa rdzing gi zhabs rdol bzhin/ zhes sogs dang*/ gsang sngags pa zhes cha lugs 'dul khrims tshul// phyi nang 'dzom 'dod don la gnyis ka med// 'dul khrims 'chal zhing dam tshig sad la bskur// nang du sgom spong phyi rol spyod pa rtsings// kha dkar zhe nag spyod tshul khra bor skyong*// chos la ngo lkog tshul chos 'gro ba bslu// log

217)'tsho'i zas rngam rang gzhan phung lam 'gro// gsang sngags bon gyer mngon rtogs khrom shar byed// dbang ma thob par rgyud la rtsal bshad dang*// ci ste dbang bskur khrims med khrom dbang byed// gzhan smin lta zhog rang srog bskyel ba'i rgyu// 'di dus grub pa thob pa'i mi re dkon/ zhes dang*/ rtsa rlung khams sems rang dbang ma thob par// dbang bzhi bskur rlom mkha' 'gro chos bsrung 'khrug /mi rung ltas dang bar chad sna tshogs 'byung*// gser chos yin zhes rin thang bcad nas kyang*// bka' brtsongs bka' 'chal dka' dang dam las 'gal// bka' yi chad pa phral la 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes sogs lung bstan pa mtha' dag mngon sum du gyur mod kyang*/ da dung bstan 'gro'i don du bsnyad btags nas/ gnyis phung don med 218)bsgrub mkhan gyi rgyal khams gang ba rnams kyi spyod tshul drang por brjod na ngag nyes gsog cing log lta dang kun slong 'phel ba'i rgyur zad la/ gtso bor ni rang nyid dag snang rab 'byams su ma gyur pa'i skyon du gor ma chags so// de ltar spyir dbang bzhi dang*/ khyad par dbang gsum pa'i 'phros don dang bcas pa'i tshul rags rim brjod nas/ da ni grol byed gdams pa'i snying po stong pa nyid zab mo'i don la dri ba gnang ba'i lan gyi tshul brda tsam 'bul te/ de las thog mar nyid kyis/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten ri rab khang khyim sogs dang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can so so'i rnam 'gyur dang*/ rang lus brdos bcas sogs chags 'jig 'pho 'gyur gyi bye brag dang*/ gsang bar dug lnga dug gsum la sogs te 'gyur dran gyi rtog tshogs mtha' 219)dag sems nyid nyid kyi cho 'phrul las ni ma 'das par thag chod na/ zhes sogs gsungs don gyi cha la/ spyir 'gro ba tha dad kyi so so'i las kyi snang tshul yang tha dad pa du mar 'byung ste/ dper na chu gcig bu la yang lha rnams kyis bdud rtsir mthong ba dang*/

lha min gyi go mtshon/ mi rnams kyi chu/ dud 'gro rnams kyis la la'i zas skom dang*/ la la'i gnas khang sogs dang*/ yi dwags rnams kyi rnag khrag dmyal ba rnams kyi khro chu khol mar mthong ba sogs/ so so'i sems kyi rang snang yin pa dang*/ bye brag tu phyi rol yul gyi snang ba 'di la'ang gang zag so so'i dbang po'i rim pas 'dzin tshul tha dad de/ 'jig rten tha mal pa rnams kyi ni snang ba a 'thas bden zhen du 'dzin/ phyi rol mu stegs pa rnams ni phywa dang dbang phyug 220)gis byas par 'dzin/ nang pa'i nyan rang rnams kyis ni rdul phran cha bcas su 'dzin/ theg chen sems tsam pas ni snang ba thams cad sems dang*/ sems rang gsal bden grub tu 'dzin/ dbu ma bas ni yul thams cad kun rdzob 'khrul snang du 'dzin/ gsang sngags pas ni ci snang lha'i dkyil 'khor du lta ba ste/ de ltar theg pa so so rang rang gi lugs kyi 'dzin tshul tha dad pa sna tshogs mchis mod kyi/ rang rang gi snad ngor de dang de dag bden na'ang*/ don dam par ni sems las gzhan du grub pa rdul tsam ma mchis te/ dri ma med snying po'i rgyud las/ 'byung ba phyi nang thams cad kun// sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa yin// nang du khams gsum rigs drug sogs// g.yo ba bcud kyi sems can dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i phung po lnga// dbang po lnga dang yul lnga dang*// rnam shes nyon mongs lnga la sogs// thams cad sems 221)kyi rang snang yin// sems las ma gtogs phyi rol na// rdul tsam skad cig grub pa med/ ces sogs dang*/ ma rig 'khor ba rang sems la// mu stegs rtag chad rang sems yin// nyan thos rang rgyal 'khor ba spong*// byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyis sbyong*// sngags su bsgyur dang shes byed pa// theg pa sna tshogs rang sems te// sems ma yin pa'i chos gzhan med// rgya mtsho'i chu las skyogs gang tsam// bcus pas de de'i don byed bzhin// theg pa'i rim pa'i chos rnams la// rang rang mthun pa'i bden pa ni// thad kar byung ba sems yin no/

zhes gsungs pa ltar/ cir snang sems kyi 'char las ni ma 'das so/ yang nyid kyis sems kyi 'gyu ba'am rnam par rtog pa las 'khor ba dang*/ mi rtog pa las myang 'das su bshad na/ zhes gsungs pa'i skabs 'di la/ 222)spyir chos spyi gzhung las de ltar gsungs te/ ji skad du/ phyogs glang gi mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal rdo rje'i bstod par/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// rnam rtog de dang bral bas na// khyod ni rtag tu mya ngan 'da'/ zhes sogs gsungs mod kyang*/ lam zab mo phyag rdzogs kyi skabs rnams su ni/ rnam rtog lam 'khyer gyi man ngag gi gnad dang ldan na/ chos sku'am rang byung ye shes nyid rnam rtog rang ngo shes pa'i rang bzhin las ma 'das tshe/ rnam par rtog pa ched du spong dgos pa ni ma yin zhing*/ mi rtog pa ched du yang mi bsgrub ste/ ji skad du/ lung las/ rnam rtog gnyen por rnam par mi rtog bsgom// mi rtog 'dod pa rtog pa chen po yin// chos kyi dbyings nyid mi rtog rtog las 'das// rtog dang mi rtog gnyis ka 223)tshig gi mtha'/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ sam bu ṭi'i rgyud las/ stong pa bsgom par mi bya zhing*// stong min bsgom par mi bya'o// stong pa mi spang rnal 'byor pas// stong min yongs su mi spang ngo*// stong dang stong min bzung bas ni// rtog pa nyung min skye bar 'gyur/ zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin/ gzhan yang*/ lar rnam rtog bkag na bsgom chen min/ zhes sogs mang du 'byung phyir/ rnam rtog mi rtog mtha' dag dgag sgrub med cing gnad kyi zin par lam du 'khyer ba lags/ yang nyid kyis/ 'gyu ba la dkar nag gnyis kyi gnyis ka 'khor ba'i rgyu yin min the tshom/ zhes gsungs pa 'di la spyir rnam rtog gam 'gyu ba dkar po ni/ dag snang mos gus snying rje sogs/ dge ba'i rigs kyi blo rnams yin phyir/ bsod nams cha

224)mthun dang*/ thar pa cha mthun sogs kyi rgyu dang*/ 'gyu ba nag po ni dug lnga dug gsum sogs mi dge ba'i bsam pa rnams te/ 'khor ba ngan song gi rgyu yin pa sogs/ chos spyi nas gsungs pa'i rgyu 'bras kyi bye brag rnams yin mod de/ klu sgrub zhabs kyi/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// des skyed las ni mi dge ba// ma chags mi sdang gti mug med/ des bskyed las ni dge ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ 'di dag gi tshul zhib par ni skabs 'dir brjod dgos par ma gyur la/ byed pa dge ba ltar snang yang bsam pa mi dge ba dang 'dres na dge bar mi rung la/ byed pa mi dge ba'i gzugs brnyan tsam snang yang bsam pa dge ba 'ba' shig pa la ni nyes med du 'gyur tshul sogs kyi rnam dbye dang dgag 225)sgrub dag la sngon sa 'bri gnyis kyi bzhed pa tha dad byung yod cing*/ spang blang tshul bzhin byed mkhan deng sang dkon par snang ba dang*/ bsam pa dang byed pa gnyis ga dge bar ming btags kyang sdig par 'gyur ba'i rigs kyang*/ dper na/ gshin po la phan phyir dge mchod sbyin sogs byed pa'i phyir sems can bsad nas skya ser gyi tshogs la 'gyed ston byed pa dang*/ srog gcod byas pas cho ga chos 'don sogs byed pa'i srol 'di ding sang kun tu dar tshe/ 'di lta bu ni gshin po la phan pa lta zhog sbyin pa po dngasbyin yul gnyis ka skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas su gda' yang su gang gis bsam mkhan mi snang bas/ des rgyu 'bras kyi gtam yang brjod dka' bar gyur mod la/ rnal 'byor dam pa dag gis ni rgyu 'bras sems su rtogs/ sems stong par rtogs kyang*/ stong nyid rgyu 'bras 226)su shar bas khyad du mi gsod cing*/ bden 'dzin gyi zhen pas kyang mi 'ching bar sgyu ma lta bu la spyod de/ de ltar shes pa dag gis ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa yang ye shes kyi tshogs chen du 'gyur ba dang*/

gzhan yang*/ ma dros pa'i mdor/ chos nyid la ni rgyu 'bras med shes kyang*// dge dang mi dge'i las ni chud mi za/ zhes gsungs pas stong nyid la bsnyad nas rgyu 'bras khyad du bsad mi rung ba dang*/ dkar po dge ba bsgrub pa rnams kyang lha mi'i bde 'bras sogs kyi rnam smin la re ba'am/ khe grags lo 'dod sogs dang ma 'dres shing sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas bya bar gsungs te/ bzang po lung bstan pa'i mdor// sgyu ma lta bu'i tshogs bsags pas// sgyu ma lta bur sangs rgyas te/ sgyu ma lta bu'i sems can don/ sgyu ma lta bur byed pa yin/ zhes gsungs pas/ mdor na gtso bor ye shes 227)kyi tshogs sam shes rab stong pa nyid kyi ma zin na/ sdig pa lta ci smos te/ dge ba yang mtho ris dang nyan rang gi rgyu tsam las/ nges legs byang chub kyi rgyur mi 'gyur bar gsungs pas na/ thabs shes zung du 'jug dgos pa nyid do/ yang nyid kyis/ gnas sa'i mi rtog pa la zhi lhag gnyis kyi gnyis ka myang 'das kyi rgyur 'gyur ram mi 'gyur/ gsungs pa 'di la/ spyir sems gnas pa'am mi rtog pa ni zhi gnas yin na'ang*/ lhag mthong ni gnas cha gcig bur rag ma lus la/ 'on kyang da res kyi dri ba mdzad pa 'di theg pa thun mong ba'i zhi lhag sogs min par/ nges don phyag rgya chen po'i lugs ltar la 'dri ba'i dgongs pa yin shas che bas na/ bdag gis kyang theg pa thun mong ba'i 228)dbu ma'i lta ba'i khrid sogs zhu myong ba'i khul tsam yin kyang*/ da lam 'di skabs su thun mong ma yin pa phyag chen gyi lugs bzhin lan 'bul rtsis lags tshe/ des na zhi lhag gi skabs 'di la yang spyi dang khyad par gnyis las/ spyi khyab tu zhi lhag gi ming tsam ni theg pa gong 'og phal cher la 'byung ba dang*/ skabs la lar ni zhi gnas la bsam gtan dang*/ lhag mthong la shes rab kyi ming gi bstan zhing*/ so so'i mtshan nyid ni/ dkon mchog sprin gyi mdor/

zhi gnas ni sems rtse gcig pa'o/ lhag mthong ni yang dag par ji lta ba bzhin du chos la so sor rtog pa'o/ zhes pa dang*/ byed las kyi dbang ltar na/ mdo de nyid las/ zhi gnas kyi ni nyon mongs pa gnon par byed do/ lhag mthong gis ni nyon mongs pa yongs su 229)sbyong bar byed do/ zhes pas gnyis ka myang 'das kyi rgyu ni yin mod la/ dbye ba ni gnyis te/ mdo dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong ni gnyis te/ shes rab las 'byung ba dang*/ gdams ngag las byung ba'o/ de la shes rab las byung ba ni mdo sde bcu gnyis kyi tshig yid la byed pa ni zhi gnas so/ de'i don rtogs pa ni lhag mthong ngo*/ gdam ngag las byung ba ni/ mnyam bzhag gis sems mi g.yo bar byed pa ni zhi gnas so/ de'i don rtogs pa ni lhag mthong ngo*/ zhes gsungs te/ 'di nyid la dpyad sgom dang 'jog sgom zhes pa'i tha snyad du ding sang grags mod/ mdor na thun mong gi zhi gnas kyi bsam gtan ni mu stegs pa rnams la yang shin tu brtan par yod kyang thar pa'i lam gyi rgyur mi 'gyur ba ste/ mu stegs kyi ston pa 230)lhag spyod kyi lo bcu gnyis zhi gnas bsgoms pas zag bcas kyi yon tan mngon shes sogs thob kyang*/ byi ba la zhe sdang skyes pa'i rkyen gyis byi la dang lhan du dmyal bar skyes ba lta bu ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdor/ 'jig rten pa dag stong nyid bsgoms na yang*// de yis dngos por 'dzin pa bzlog mi nus/ de las nyon mongs phyir yang rab tu ldang*// lhag spyod kyi ni ting 'dzin 'di bsgoms bzhin/ zhes pas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zhi gnas sam mchog gi zhi gnas nyid dgos par gsungs la/ gzhan yang gzugs khams kyi lha'i bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ gzugs med gyi bsam gtan bzhi/ nyan thos 'gog pa'i ting 'dzin dang bcas te snyom 'jug dgu po rnams kyang zhi gnas kyi bye brag yin pas/

de dag gis kyang gnas skabs kyi yon tan mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs dpag med yod na'ang mthar thug byang chub 231)kyi lam bsgrub pa la ni lhag mthong gis ma zin na don med pas/ lhag mthong kho na gal che ba'i tshul yang*/ slob dpon ār+ya de was/ bsam gtan nags mes yang dang yang du ni// nyon mongs tshang tshing bsreg par gyur na yang*// bdag lta'i rtsa ba brtan po ma spangs pas// char gyi rlan bzhin mos pa rab tu skye/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ gsar ma'i mkhas pa mang pos/ rnying ma'i rdzogs chen ni hwa shang gi lta ba dang mthun no zhes pa'i bka' bkyon mang po mdzad na'ang*/ rdzogs chen gyi lo rgyus rnams su ni/ sngon chos rgyal khri srong gi sku gnyer ba myang ban ting 'dzin bzang pos rgya nag gi hwa shangazhig la sgom gyi man ngag zhus te nan tan du bsgoms pas/ zas skom mi dgos par nyin zhag mang por zhi gnas la 'byams shing mngon par shes pa thobs pas sgom bzang por 232)rlom yod pa'i tshe/ paṇa chen bi ma ma dang mjal nas sgom gyi rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ bi ma'i zhal nas/ khyed kyi bsgom de 'dras ni bskal par gnyid mi sad pa'i klu'i rigs su skye/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyur mi 'gro gsungs pa la brten nas/ myang ban bag chags sad de paṇa chen de nyid la rdzogs chen nazhus nas bsgoms pas/ 'ja' lus grub tshul gyi lo rgyus sogs yod phyir/ des na zhi gnas ni lhag mthong gi rten gzhi tsam ma gtogs gnas cha'i bsam gtan gcig bus ni phyag rgya chen po'i sgom tshad ldan du mi rung ba dang*/ khyad par gnas nyams la zhen 'dzin yod pa dag ni sgom gyi gol sar 'gyur tshul dag kyang gsar rnying gi khrid gzhung mtha' dag dgongs pa mthun no/ zhi lhag gnyis po yang ye gdod ma'i gnas lugs sam/ bzhugs tshul lam/ yin lugs kyi dbang du ni ngo bo gnyis med zung 'jug 233)tu yod tshe/ gang zag dbang po rab rnams la ni zhi lhag tha dad mi dbye bar gdod ma'i yin tshul ji bzhin du ngo sprad nas de ka ltar nyams su blangs pas/

zhi lhag tsam du ma zad snang srid 'khor 'das mtha' dag rig stong phyag rgya chen po 'ba' zhig gi rol par 'char zhing*/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ji lta ba mngon du 'gyur mod kyang*/ gang zag dbang po 'bring tha rnams khrid thabs la dgongs nas/ thog mar zhi gnas nyid la'ang mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i zhi gnas kyi bre brag ma dag pa'i shing bu rde'u dang*// dag pa ye shes kyi lha dang*// yig 'bru thig le rlung sbyong sogs la brten nas sems gnas thabs dang*/ mtshan ma med pa'i zhi gnas la'ang*/ bsgrims pa/ glod pa/ grim lhod spel ma sogs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas khrid pa'i phyag bzhes yod mod kyi/ 'di dag ni dper na yi ge slob pa'i tshe dang 234)por ka kha sogs nas rim can du slob pa'i tshul dang mtshungs pa yin mod kyang*/ gtso bor ni gsang sngags kyi lam 'dir sgom tshad ldan rgyud la skye bar byed pa la bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa gal che bar gsungs te/ rgyud las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed pa// bla ma'i dus thabs brten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ zhes sogs dang*/ skyob pa rin po ches/ gsang sngags byin rlabs lam pa yin// bla ma'i byin rlabs ma zhugs par// ji ltar byas kyang blos byas yin/ gsungs shing*/ ༈ khyad par phyag rgya chen po'i zhi gnas mtshan med dngos la bslab pa'i skabs su/ da lta'i phyag chen la la dag ni sems kyi 'gyu ba bkag nas 'jur 'dzin la nan tan byed par gda' yang*/ sngon gyi grub thob rnams kyi gsungs pa'i gzhung man ngag thams cad las ni sems rang babs su 235)'jog thabs kho nar gsungs te/ de yang*/ tel+lo pas/ 'das la mi mno ma 'ongs mi bsam zhing*// da ltar ba la mi sems blos mi bsgom// rtog pas mi dpyad sems ni rnam par glod/ ces dang*/ sha wa ris/ rlung ni mi bzung yid ni mi bcings bar// ma bcos shes pa bu chung lta bur zhog

ces sogs dang*/ mnyam med dwags po pas/ bcas bcod ma byed lhug par zhog /lta nyul ma mang rang sar zhog /yid la ma byed dmigs med zhog ces sogs dang*/ yang dgon pa'i ngo sprod bdun par/ blo rtog pa la skyon du mi lta zhing*// mi rtog pa ched du ma bsgrub par// sems rang lugs su zhog la rgyang so tshugs dang*// sgom zhi gnas kyi mthil du phebs pa gcig 'ong gi zhes sogs bka' rgyud gong ma rnams kyi ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du bsgom shes pa zhig gal che bar go'o/ ༈ 236) de bzhin du rnying ma'i phyag chen thams cad nas kyang de ka ltar gsungs te/ phyag chen ma rig mun sel las// lus ni rnam snang chos bdun bya// yid ni ma bcos bya byed bral// spros bral ngang la lhan sbyor bzhag /ma bcos ngang las ma yengs sems// 'dzin med blo bral ngang du bzhag /gzung 'dzin rnam rtog 'phro ba na// 'phro mkhan kho re'i ngo bor lta// ma rnyed sngar bzhin glod la bzhag /snga phyi'i rtog pa rags pa kun// rang sar zhi ste lhan ner gnas// bde gsal mi rtog ngang nyid du// lhod de shig ger gnas pa 'byung*// de ni zhi gnas gtan la phebs// lhag mthong shar ba'i rtags tsam yin/ zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs shing*/ de lta bu'i gnas cha'i bsam gtan la brtson pas nyams su blangs pa las/ g.yo ba'i nyams/ goms pa'i nyams/ brtan pa'i nyams/ mthar phyin pa'i nyams rnams rim par 237)'char zhing*/ 'di rnams la khrid gzhung la lar ni/ gnas pa dang po ri gzar 'bab chu lta bu/ gnyis pa chu bo dal 'bab lta bu/ gsum pa rgya mtsho mi g.yo lta bu zhes pa'i dpe don du sbyar nas bstan mod la/ 'di dag la brtan pa thob pa'i nyams rtags su zag bcas kyi mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs phran tshegs skyes pa la rlom sems dang nga rgyal gyis khengs te/ lam log par gol nyen byung bas na/ bla ma nyams myong can bsten la gol sar ma shor ba gal che bar gsungs so/

༈ de ltar sngar bshad pa ltar 'jig rten pa'i zhi gnas blos byas yid byed can dang*/ tshor ba 'gags pa'i mun sgom sogs kyis ni myang 'das kyi lam du mi 'gro ba'i phyir/ ༈ phyag rgya chen po'i sgom gyi rten gzhir gyur pa'i zhi gnas ni gong du bstan pa'i ma bcos sor 'jog 'di nyid kho na dgos par bzhed cing*/ 'ga' 238)zhig gnas cha tsam rnyed kyang rig pa'i dwangs cha ma thon par btang snyoms lung ma bstan bying rmugs su 'byams pa de ni bogs mi 'byung zhing gol sar 'chor te/ ji skad du/ o rgyan gyis/ rig pa'i rang rtsal ma lhongs par// gnas pa ngar med lteng po ba// bogs ni cung zad mi 'byung bas// rig pa gsal ngar thon pa gces// sgom mkhan mang ste sgom shes nyung*/ zhes gsungs pas gnad dang ldan pa gal che bar gda' lags/ ༈ de ltar zhi gnas kyi tshul brda mtshon bshad tsam nas/ lhag mthong dngos kyi don stong pa nyid kyi ye shes 'di la/ nyid kyi gsungs pa ltar/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ zhes sogs ni sems nyid rang gi ngo bo'i cha nas gsungs la/ yang*/ brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog ces sogs ni mtshan nyid 239)gsal la ma 'gag pa'i cha nas gsungs pa ste/ de gnyis 'gal 'du ltar ma yin par stong gsal zung 'jug chen por gdod nas lhun gyis grub pa lags mod cing*/ lar/ sgom phyag rgya chen po zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa 'di nyid la yang ngos 'dzin lugs kyi bzhed pa mi gcig pa mang ste/ rgya gar tel+lo pa dang*/ de'i slob ma na ro pa dang bcas pa ni thabs shes gnyis las thabs gtso bor mdzad de/ bde stong lhan skyes kyi ye shes la phyag rgya chen por bzhed cing*/ nyams len kyang thabs lam la gnad du bsnun par mdzad pa'i phyag srol mar pa mi la ras chung sogs kyi 'dzin pa dang*/ yang*/ mai tri pa dang de'i bla ma ri khrod dbang phyug de'i bla ma sa ra ha dang bcas pas ni shes rab stong nyid gtso bor mdzad de rig stong phyag rgya chen po'am/

a ma na si ka ra te 240)yid la mi byed pa zhes bya ba/ ma bcos sor 'jog kho na'i don gyi ye shes la phyag rgya chen por bzhed pa'i phyag srol mar mi nas brgyud de/ mnyam med dwags pos lhan cig skyes sbyor rgya cher spel bar mdzad la/ bzhed srol 'di nyid dang bstun te phyis su yang gar dbang chos kyi grags pa sogs kyis kyang*/ bde stong phyag chen dang*/ rig stong ngam/ gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i yig cha mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan yang bod 'dir rje sa skya pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams ni phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba dbang don gyi ye shes nyid yin pas dbang gal che ba yin zhes/ nyams len kyang rgyu lam 'bras gsum gyi dbang la gtso bor mdzad pa dang*/ dpal ldan 'brug pa yab sras dang khyad par rgyal ba rgod tshang pa sogs ni thol skyes kyi shes pa grwa ma nyams pa nyid la 241)bzhed pa dang*/ mkhas grub ko brag pa ni sems byung gnas 'gro gsum btsal bas ma rnyed pa'i rang ngo la bzhed pa dang*/ kun mkhyen bu ston sogs ni bde gshegs snying po la bzhed nas/ gzhi'i bshad pa gtso cher mdzad pa dang*/ jo nang pas ni sems can gyi rgyud la 'bras bu'i yon tan mtshan dpe sogs rdzogs pa zhig la bzhed nas 'bras bu'i bshad pa gtso bor mdzad pa dang*/ bo dong pas ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'ba' shig la bzhed de dbu ma ltar stong phyogs kyi bshad pa gtso bor mdzad pa dang*/ dge ldan pas kyang de bzhin du dbu ma'i lta ba la bzhed pa dang*/ zhang tshal pas ni 'od gsal chen po la bzhed pa dang*/ 'bri gung pas ni rang rig nyag gcig la bzhed pa sogs/ mthar thug gi dgongs pa la khyad cher med rung*/ rnam pa ltar gtso bor 'don 242)tshul mtha' yas mod kyi/ kam tshang sgrub rgyud kyi bzhed pa ni/ rgyud sde thams cad kyi mthar thug gi dgongs pa thabs shes gnyis med gyi ye shes gnyug ma lhan skyes kyi dbyings su rang shar so ma snang rig rjen pa 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po'am lhag mthong gi ngo bor bzhed de/

dpal mkha' spyod pas mdzad pa'i phyag chen ngo sprod las/ gsal rig tu snang zhing ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub la/ gdod nas grub pa cung zad kyang med bzhin du sna tshogs su du mar snang bas/ snang rig stong gsum zung 'jug dbyer med ro mnyam pa 'di nyid phyag rgya chen po'am/ rang sems sangs rgyas kyi rang zhal mngon sum du snang ba yin no/ zhes gsungs shing*/ de dang mthun par sgrub rgyud gong ma rnams kyi gsung bgros rnams las rgya cher 'byung mod la/ snying ma'i phyag chen dag gi bzhed don yang de bzhin de/ ༈ gu ru rin po 243)che'i phyag chen zhal gdams las/ sems nyid phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la zer ba yin/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad dang por byung yang sems nyid las byung*/ da lta yang sems nyid kyi ngang la gnas/ mthar grol ba yang sems kyi klong du thim phyir thams cad sems nyid las ma 'das sems de nyid bla ma'i byin rlabs dang gdams ngag gi zin rang rig rang ngo shes na mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad bskyed pa'i gzhi yin/ de ci'i phyir na/ sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas ma skyes pa chos kyi sku/ rang mdangs 'gag med du gsal ba longs sku/ rol rtsal thugs rje kun la khyab pa sprul pa'i sku/ de gsum gdod nas dbyer med lhun grub tu bzhugs pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ de ltar rtogs pas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad lhun grub tu 'byung ba'o/ zhes dang*/ sems nyid ye gdod 244)ma nas skye ba med pa las/ 'gag med du 'khor 'das kyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs shar yang skye med kyi rol pa las ma 'das/ de'i phyir snang ba thams cad stong pa/ stong pa'i rang mdangs snang ba ste snang stong gnyis su med do/ zhes sogs dang*/ de la thabs shes dbyer med ces kyang bya ste/ 'gag med dran snang gi ye shes thabs/ de'i rang bzhin skye ba med pa shes rab/

thabs shes gnyis med kyi ye shes chen po de ni chos thams cad kyi bzhugs tshul lo/ zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang phyag chen klong yangs mtha' bral las// zhi gnas lhag mthong zhes bya ba// rnam rtog nyon mongs rang sar zhi// yid la byar med zhi gnas te// lhag mthong snang srid sems su rtogs// mnyam bzhag sems la las mi bkol// rang babs lhug par 'jog pa'o// rjes shes phra 245)rags rnam rtog yin/ zhes dang*/ sems rtsal ma 'gag snang ba ste// rang bzhin shes pa stong pa'o// dmigs pa med pa lta ba ste// 'dzin med skyong ba sgom pa'o// dgag sgrub med pa spyod pa la// 'bras bu re dogs bral ba'o// 'jig rten zhen pa lings kyi bor// 'khrul pa'i snang ba shigs kyi bshig /bag chags 'dzin zhen bun gyi thong*// shed pa rang sor lhod kyi glod// chos nyid ngang la lhan gyi zhog /sangs rgyas kun gyis mes po sems// sems kyi de nyid rtogs pa gces// sum cu rtsa bdun byang chub chos// sa bcu lam lnga phar phyin drug /sku gsum sku lnga ye shes lnga// de sogs chos rnams thams cad kun// sems nyid thig le nyag gcig gi// gzhi rtsa chod na de la 'dus/ ces pa la sogs/ rig 'dzin grub thob thams cad mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig tu/ chos thams cad 246)kyi rtsa ba rang sems la rang dbang thob dgos par gsungs mod kyang*/ kha chos tshig gi lta sgom la 'byams pa dang*/ blun sgom yid byed bcos ma'i sgom zhen mkhan mang bas/ des na gtso bor mtshan ldan gyi slob ma'i khams dang dbang po'i bye brag tha dad pa/ rim gyis pa/ cig char ba/ thod rgal ba sogs gang dang gang de'i rigs dang bstun pa'i khrid thabs kyis/ dang por thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro rnams la nan chags rtags thon du bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi nyid la'ang khrid tshul gyi phyag bzhes tha dad kyi/ sgom thog nas lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa'am/

lta thog nas sgom pa gtan la 'bebs pa sogs gang ltar byed rung*/ dgos don la sems kyi gzhi rtsa chod pa zhig gal che ba'i phyir/ 'ol tshod dang*/ go yul dang*/ rna 247)thos dang*/ dpe la ltas pa'i tshig dred sogs ma yin par/ rang nyams la thag chod kyi sems tshol bya zhing brdar sha bshad nas/ skabs la nam babs tshe ngo sprod gnad bsnun du gdab pa ma gtogs/ dus min skabs min du gdams ngag gi zab tshig 'chol bar bshad na/ slob ma myong med kha 'khyer mkhan du 'gyur phyir/ gnad mtshams kyi bye brag shes pa gal che bar gda' lags/ ༈ skabs 'dir/ nyid kyi dwags po thar rgyan nas gsungs pa ltar/ dpe rigs lung gsum gyi sgo nas/ stong pa nyid la lta nyes na// shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyur/ zhes pa'i skyon sel gyi skabs don zhib rgyas su stsal ba'i cha la/ spyir bstan bcos yid bzhin gyi nor bu thar pa rin po che'i rgyan 'di nyid bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres kyi dgongs 248)pa bstan la phabs te/ mdo sngags thun mong las kyang mdo lugs gtso che bar gsungs shing theg chen gyi lam rim du mdzad pa yin phyir/ shes rab gyi le'u bstan pa'i stong nyid 'di ni dbu ma'i lta ba gtso cher gsungs pa dang*/ lam thabs kyi cha rnams kyang phar phyin drug gtso bor bstan la/ lung sbyor rnams kyang dbu ma'i gzhung dang byams chos sogs shas cher drangs par mdzad phyir/ mdor na thun mong theg pa dang sgo mtshungs par yod pa ste/ phyag rgya chen po'i bzhed don dngos ni/ rje sgam po pa nyid kyi zhal gdams gab pa mngon phyungs sogs bstan bcos dang zhus lan gzhan rnams las gsal bar lags shing*/ lar yang mdo sngags gnyis po lta ba la khyad par med kyang thabs kyi khyad par yin no zhes phal cher gyis bzhed mod kyang*/ nyams su 249)len rgyu ni lta ba'i don de nyid yin tshe/ don de nyid rtogs tshul lam sgom tshul ni thabs yin/

de la khyad yod pa de kas lta ba nyid cung zad khyad yod par grub ste/ de yang rgyu mtshan nyid theg pa'i lta ba bzang shos ni dbu ma yin la/ dbu ma rang gi nang tshan gyi dbye ba mang yang*/ spyi mthun gyi sgom pa'i skabs su/ mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bur bsgom par bshad cing*/ mnyam bzhag gi stong nyid nam mkha' lta bu de yang lung rigs dang brtag dpyad kho nas gzhig ste/ sems kyi ngo bo gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong par blos bsgrub nas gtan la 'bebs par byed cing*/ bsgom pa'i tshe yang rnam rtog mtha' dag ched du spangs pa'i rtog med nam mkha' lta bu mnyam par 'jog la/ rjes shes dang rjes snang kun la sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dzin stangs sam 250)mos blo rgyas 'debs byed pa 'ba' zhig snang mod/ ༈ phyag chen du ni sems kyi gnas tshul lam/ 'char tshul gang ltar 'dug pa de ka bzo med lhug par rang rig ye shes su lam du 'khyer ba ma gtogs dgag sgrub mi byed pa dang*/ sems 'tshol gyi dus na yang mtshan nyid theg par blos brtag dang yid byed bsam mno kho nas 'tshol bar byed cing*/ de ltar btsal bas ma brnyed pa khang stong gi rkun ma lta bu'am/ ma grub pa'i stong pa la gshis su byed mod kyi/ ༈ phyag chen pas ni mnyam bzhag gi thog nas rang gi rang ngo la bltas te/ kha dog dbyibs mtshan du grub ma grub dang*/ byung sa gnas sa 'gro sa sogs yod med kyi brdar sha bcad pas/ 'tshol mkhan gyi rig pa kho rang las gzhan du med par thag chod cing*/ 'tshol bya 'tshol byed gnyis med kyi shes pa stong gsal 251)zung 'jug gi rang ngo mthong bar 'gyur phyir/ des na khyad par shin tu che ba nyid de/ blos gzhig cing gtan tshigs dang brtag dpyad kyis stong par byas pa de la stong pa ji bzhin par mi bzhed de/ 'jam dpal grags pas/ phung po rnam dpyad stong pa ni// chu shing ji bzhin snying po med// rnam pa thams cad mchog ldan pa'i// stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ma yin/

zhes sogs gsungs shing blo yi bcos ma dang brtag dpyad kho nas ni blo 'das kyi don mi rtogs pa'i tshul ni/ te lo pas/ blo yi chos kyi blo 'das don mi rtogs// byas pa'i chos kyi byar med sangs mi rgya// blo 'das byar med don de rtogs 'dod na// rang sems rtsa ba chod la rig pa gcer bur zhog ces gsungs pas na/ rgyu'i theg pa'i lta sgom rnams phyag rgya chen po'i skabs 'di dang cung zad bzhed pa mi mthun pa 252)dang*/ ༈ khyad par du stong nyid la lta nyes na phung ba'i tshul ni/ rgyal ba thabs la mkhas pa'i gang zag tha mal pa dang*/ nyan rang sogs dngos por 'dzin pa'i zhen pa las bzlog phyir stong nyid bstan pa yin mod kyang*/ stong nyid la mchog 'dzin byas na dngos 'dzin las kyang skyon che bar 'gyur tshul/ rje sgam po pas/ dpe rigs lung gsum gyis bstan pa ltar/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las 'od srungs/ gang bdag tu blta ba ri rab tsam ni sla yi mngon pa'i nga rgyal can stong pa nyid du lta ba ni de ltar ma yin no zhes dang*/ bram ze chen pos/ dngos por 'dzin pa phyugs las blun pa ste// stong par 'dzin pa de bas kyang ni blun/ zhes sogs lung mang mod cing*/ stong 'dzin des phung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ don dam gyi stong nyid blo 'das yin pa la/ 'di blos 253)byas su gyur pas byang chub kyi lam du mi 'gro ba'i khar/ stong pa kho na zhen pa de ni chad ltar 'gyur la/ de ni ngan song gi rgyu 'ba' shig ste/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdor/ las kyi rnam smin rgyu 'bras mi 'dod pa// de ni mu stegs chad par smra ba ste// shi ma thag tu mnar med dmyal bar skye// de ni rang phung gzhan yang rlag par byed/ ces gsungs so/ ༈ gzhan yang bod 'dir mkhas rloms la las/ phyag rdzogs gnyis kyi lta sgom dang*/ khyad par spyod pa blang dor bral ba sogs kyi chos skad la hwa shang gi grub mtha' dang thun mong mnyam pa mdzad mod kyang*/

hwa shang ni thabs kyi cha dang rgyu 'bras sogs gang mi 'dod par/ dran pa med cing yid la byar med pa/ ces/ gsal cha thams cad bkag 254)pa'i mi rtog pa gnyid thug po lta bu'i gti mug la sgom du 'dod par snang la/ de dang phyag rdzogs kyi gsal stong zung 'jug gi ye shes gnyis nam yang mtshungs pa'i skabs med pa dang*/ rdzogs chen gyi tshig 'ga' zhig tu/ dran bsam las 'das pa zhes dang*/ phyag chen du yid la mi byed pa/ zhes pa rnams ni blos byas kyi bzo bcos sogs tha mal 'khrul pa'i bsam blo byed pa la gsungs pa yin cing*/ spyod pa dgag sgrub blang dor med pa de yang*/ mnyam bzhag gi rang ngo la dge sdig dang bzang ngan sogs mtshan 'dzin gyis ma gos pa'i 'dus ma byas kyi chos la zer ba yin gyi/ nam du'ang dge sdig med ces rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa ni ma yin zhing*/ thabs shes ya ma bral bar nyams len la gnad du bsnun pa ni phyag rdzogs kyi bzhed don gtso bo yin pas/ 255)des na jo bo rjes gsungs pa ltar/ gzhi bden gnyis zung 'jug lam thabs shes sam tshogs gnyis zung 'jug 'bras bu sku gnyis zung 'jug tu dgongs pa mthun pa lags/ ༈ gzhan yang*/ mnyam med sgam po pas/ phar phyin theg pa bas ni rten 'brel sogs lung rigs kyi sgo nas snang la rang bzhin med par gtan la phabs te bsgom pa yin/ mos pas stong nyid du byed pa yin te dbu ma pa'i sgom lugs yin/ de rang yang bsgom bya sgom byed dang bcas pa'i gnyis 'dzin gyi blor 'dug pas/ des lta ba ma rtogs/ dngos 'dzin la gnod pa bskyal bas/ sgrib pa dpag tu med pa 'dzad nus te 'tshang rgya mi nus/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang gzhan dag mi rtog pa dum gcig la mnyam bzhag byas nas/ rjes rmi lam sgyu ma ltar bsgom pa yin/ bla ma mi la'i lugs la 256)dug lnga dang rnam rtog thams cad gnyis med ye shes su 'khyer nas/ gom tsa na mnyam rjes dang mthun mtshams med par lam du 'khyer ba yin no/

zhes sogs gsungs pa 'di dag ni phyag chen gyi bzhed don thun mong ma yin pa rjen phyungs su bstan pa gda' lags/ ༈ yang nyid kyis/ stong nyid mtshan med kyi sgom pas ngan 'gror phyogs na/ mtshan bcas kyi sgom pas de bas the tshom/ gsungs pa 'di la/ spyir stong pa nyid kyi don phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa ni chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin te/ de'i phyir rgyal ba'i yum zhes kyang bya/ chos kyi dbyings zhes kyang bya/ shes rab ces kyang bya/ btsun mo'i bha ga dang*/ mkha' dbyings dang chos 'byung dang*/ e wam̐ sogs gsang sngags kyi brda don rtags gsum thams cad 'di lta bu'i don mtshon phyir sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa'i tshig tu gsungs shing*/ nges don 257)gyi mdo sde rnams las stong nyid bco brgyad kyi dbye bsdu gsungs pa thams cad dang*/ sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs kun gyi yang 'byung gnas yin mod la/ dper na phyi'i nam mkha' ni snod bcud thams cad kyi bskyed pa'i gzhi'am 'byung gnas yin pa ltar/ stong pa nyid las 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad dang por de'i klong las shar zhing*/ mthar yang de'i dbyings su thim pa ste/ 'bras bu dri ma med pa'i rgyud las/ 'khor 'das ma lus bskyed pa'i gzhi// cir yang ma grub chos kyi dbyings// kun la khyab cing yangs pa'i klong*// ye shes nam mkha'i dbyings lta bu// skye med ngang las skye ba yin// sna tshogs cho 'phrul cir yang snang*// grub pa med las mngon sum du// snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad grub// thams cad gnas lugs don la gcig /spros dang bral ba'i chos nyid do/ zhes pa ltar yin mod kyang don ji bzhin ma rtogs pa rnams kyis ni 'khrul 258)pa 'byung ba'i gzhi yang yin phyir/ stong gsal zung 'jug gi mtshang ma rig par/ stong pa phyang chad dam/ nyi tshe ba'i stong pa sogs 'dzin stangs log pas ngan 'gror phyogs pa ma gtogs/ yang dag pa'i stong pa nyid rtogs pa la ni/
