ngan 'gror 'gro mkhan dang*/ 'gro rgyu 'gro sa sogs ma grub la/ khyad par phyag rgya chen po'i skabs 'dir/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po gdod ma'i gnas lugs sam bde gshegs snying po 'pho 'gyur bri gang med pa'i chos nyid stong gsal rig pa'i snying po can ye nas lhun grub tu gnas pa la/ lam phyag rgya chen po zhi lhag dang bskyed rdzogs dang thabs shes dang tshogs gnyis sogs zab cing myur ba'i rim pa du mas blo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma sbyangs pas 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid gzhan nas ma btsal rang las rang byung lhun grub chen po'i chos kyi rgyal 259)srid la rang dbang 'byor ba ste/ des na stong nyid ji lta ba mngon du gyur pa'i yon tan lags shing*/ mtshan bcas kyis kyang ngan 'gro'i rgyu rkyen byed mi byed ni gang zag la rag pa nyid de/ de yang mtshan bcas kyi bye brag ni/ thun mong theg par byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang*/ phar phyin drug sogs lam gyi chos thams cad dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags ltar na bskyed pa'i rim pa rgyas bsdus rnams dang*/ rtsa rlung thig le'i sgom rim sogs mtshan bcas kyi dmigs pa la brten pa thams cad yin mod kyi de rnams kyang gdams pa'i gnad kyis zin na mtshan bcas dang mtshan med dbyer med pa kho na ste/ gdams pa'i gnad gang yin na 'khor gsum yongs dag 'ba' shig yin te/ de yang byang chub kyi sems lta bu la mtshon na/ sems bskyed bya'i yul/ skyed byed kyi mkhan 260)po/ bskyed rgyu'i sems dang bcas pa thams cad rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi dbyings su ro gcig par rtogs pa dang*/ de bzhin du pha rol tu phyin pa sogs la'ang shes par bya ste/ de ltar shes na mtshan bcas sam dmigs bcas mtha' dag kyang bla med rdzogs byang gi rgyur 'gyur ba ste/ ji skad du/ bzang po lung bstan pa'i mdor/ chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin med pa ste// sems can dang ni sangs rgyas mtshan nyid med// mtshan nyid med la mtshan du 'dod pa de// sangs rgyas la ni shin tu ring bar 'gyur// chos yod mi kun rtog pas bslad/

dngos po med par yang ni rab tu shes// byed pa gang dag byed pa po las 'das// ming du 'dzin pa stong par rab tu ston// gang gi rgyu rkyen rang bzhin med shes pa// de ni chags bral gyur pas chos kyang shes// 'dod chags bral ba'i chos ni shes gyur pa// de ni rnam dag mig gis sangs rgyas mthong*/ 261)zhes sogs gsungs shing*/ de bzhin du sngags kyi bskyed rim sogs mtshan bcas kyi dmigs pa thams cad kyang de'i de nyid tshul bzhin shes pa gal che ste/ gang bsgom pa'i bskyed rim de dag kyang smin byed bum dbang gi skabs su bla mas ji ltar ngo sprad pa bzhin/ snod bcud phung khams skye mched du snang ba mtha' dag ye nas lha'i rang bzhin yin pa la yin par nges shes bskyed pa ma gtogs ma yin pa la yin par bsgom pa'i blos btags pa ni ma yin te/ de ltar btags na log pa'i kun rdzob tu gyur te/ dper na/ sol ba la dung du sgom kyang mi 'grub pa lta bu'o/ de bzhin du rtsa rlung khams kyi byed cing dang*/ dmigs pa sogs kyang ye nas yod pa'i rang bzhin dngos po'i gnas lugs mngon du byed pa'i thabs dang rten 'brel gyi zab gnad yin te/ med pa la yod par 262)bsgom pa lta bu ma yin no/ gang zhig bsgom pa de dag kyang a 'thas mngon zhen rtag pa ther zug tu bsgoms na mtshan bcas kyi gol sa yin mod kyi/ snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma chu zla lta bu dang*/ de nyid kyang don dam par spros mtshan las 'das pa rang sems phyag rgya chen po'i rnam rol nyid tu thag chod tshe/ gegs skyon dang gol sa'i gzhi gtan nas ma grub pa kho na ste/ de lta bu'i tshul yang*/ snying po'i rgyud las/ lhan cig skyes pa'i sems nyid la// sgom med sgom pa po yang med// lha med sngags kyang yod ma yin// spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin la// lha dang sngags ni yang dag gnas// de nyid rtogs pa'i thabs su ni// dngul rdo dngul du ma bzhus bar// btul dang bzo ru mi nyan pas// gser dngul bzhu btul byed pa bzhin/

263)/dbang gi smin byas bskyed rim gyis// 'bras bu gtan la 'bebs pa yin/ zhes dang*/ phung po lnga ni rigs lnga la// rigs lnga ye shes lnga yin te// 'byung ba lnga ni yum lnga'o// rdo rje'i skye mched phyi nang rnams// sems dpa' sems ma'i dkyil 'khor mchog /chos sku gcig gi ngang nyid las// sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir// zhing khams sprul pas nam mkha' khyab// mtha' yas sku ru ston par mdzad// mthar thug bskyed du med pa ste// rang snang ye shes lha ru rdzogs// lha nyid sems la sems nyid lha// shel dang 'od gnyis dbyer med bzhin// lha dang sems nyid gnyis su med// gnyis med rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin/ zhes sogs dang*// dper na ba bzhon 'o ma ni// lus kun khyab kyang rwa mjug nas// 'then yang 'o ma mi 'byung la// nu mar 'then pas 'byung ba ltar// de bzhin rang rig 264)chos kyi sku// rdo rje gsum gyi gnas lugs la// thabs dang man ngag gnad shes na/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan kun// rjes dpag ma yin mngon sum 'byung*// tshe gcig mngon par sangs rgyas 'gyur/ zhes gsungs phyir sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du ye nas gnas pa'i gzhi de la/ lam smin grol zab mo'i thabs la brten nas gnad du bsnun pas/ 'bras bu rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan mngon gyur du 'byung ba ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i zab gnad lags tshe/ mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi bskyed rdzogs bla ma'i man ngag dang byin rlabs thob na dka' ba med pa nyid do/ ༈ lar yang bskyed rim gyi skabs su/ thog mar swa bhā wa'i sngags kyi stong par sbyang ba de yang*/ chos thams cad kyi ye gdod ma'i gnas lugs kyi gshis stong pa nyid 'khor 'das thams cad la ye khyab tu 265)yod pa'i rang bzhin de nyid dran zhing gsal 'debs pa lta bu'i don yin mod kyang*/

deng sang ni snod bcud kyi snang ba mtha' dag dngos med du gtong ba'i stong ba nyi tshe ba zhig la swa bhā wa'i sngags don du 'dod mkhan mang bar mchis shing*/ bskyed rim gyi sngon 'dir gdod ma'i gnas lugs kyi stong chen de dran dgos pa'i rgyu gang yin zhe na/ de ni gong du bshad pa ltar/ chos thams cad kyi yum shes rab phar phyin zhes kyang bya ba ste/ myang 'das kyi chos mtha' dag de'i dbyings las 'byung dgos phyir/ stong nyid de ka'i rang gdangs gsal cha 'gag med kyi rol pa'i cho 'phrul du gzhal yas khang dang lha'i rnam pa sna tshogs su sprul zhing shar la/ ji ltar shar ba'i sgyu 'phrul de dag kyang a 'thas gdod bcas su ma grub par/ sems nyid stong chen gyi dbyings las ma g.yos pa'i 266)snang stong zung 'jug chen po de la bskyed rim gyi ming du btags pa dang*/ gang bsgoms pa'i lha tshogs de dag kyang*/ rnam pa gsal bas chad mthar ma lhung*/ rnam dag dran pas rtag mthar ma lhung*/ nga rgyal brtan pas res 'jog dum chad lta bur ma gyur par sgo gsum rdo rje gsum las mi 'da' bar dgos pa nyid du gsar rnying gi rgyud dang sgrub thabs phal mo cher 'byung na'ang*/ de ltar nyams len du mdzad mkhan kyang dkon pa dang*/ yang*/ la la'i bzhed kyis/ thog mar bskyed rim bsgom shing mthar rdzogs rim la bsdu ba ni skye ba dang*/ 'chi ba lam du lhongs phyir la dgongs pa ste/ klu sgrub yab sras sogs kyi srol yin par bshad pa dang*/ yang*/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu bsgom pa ni nā ro yab sras kyi bzhed srol yin pa ste/ de ltar bzhed srol tha dad du yod par grags mod kyang*/ dam pa de dag 267)don gyi dgongs pa la tha mi dad par gor ma chags shing*/ gnas skabs gdul bya'i mos blo dang dbang po'i khyad par la dgongs pa sogs dang*/ 'ga' zhig ni rgyud sde so so'i skabs don gyi khyad par tsam ma gtogs/

mthar thug gi don la ni bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug kho na las ma 'das te/ ci'i phyir na/ dang po'i gzhi yang bden gnyis zung 'jug dang*/ mthar mngon gyur gyi 'bras bu yang sku gnyis zung 'jug yin pa'i phyir ro/ des na dang por yang stong nyid kyi klong las shar/ mthar yang gdod ma'i gnas lugs kyi ngang du thim zhing*/ shar thim gnyis ka don la zung 'jug sems nyid gsal stong las ma 'das par gsungs gda' na'ang*/ ding sang ni/ bskyed rdzogs ya bral res 'jog 'ba' shig byed mkhan dang*/ yang*/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len gang yang rang gzhan 268)mkha' khyab kyi 'gro kun bla med byang chub kyi rgyu kho nar 'bad dgos na'ang*/ da lta'i bskyed rim dang bsnyen sgrub sogs byed mkhan rnams ni/ rang nyid gcig bu gnas skabs tshe dang longs spyod 'phel phyir ram/ nad gdon sogs zhi phyir dang*/ las tshogs phan gnod phran bu 'grub phyir la bsams nas/ lha sngags la brtson blo byed pa 'di dag ni/ yang dag pa'i bskyed rims su 'gro ba yang dka' zhing*/ brda don rtags gsum tshul bzhin mi shes par lha sngags rang rgyud par zhen pa de ni yi dwags gshen rje gshed kyi gzugs can du skyes tshul gyi gtam brgyud nyams bzhin 'byung nyen du gda' bas/ ༈ des na chos gang dang gang rnasam su len kyang*/ gzhung dang bla ma'i man ngag tshad ldan zhig rgyud la 'khel ba nyid gal che bar go lags/ ces 'phros don du gsol ba'o// ༈ 269)yang nyid kyis/ khrid yig sogs thams cad du sems la byung sa gnas sa 'gro sa sogs ma grub par gsungs na/ zab mo nang don rang 'grel las/ gsang sngags rnying lugs ltar/ snying ga'i dwangs ma lnga 'dus sogs la brten nas sems snying gar gnas tshul gsungs pa 'di ji ltar yin zhes 'dri bar mdzad pa'i skabs don la/ spyir yang rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos thams cad bden pa gnyis su 'du bas na/ 'di skabs su yang*/

sems nyid rang gi ngo bo'i cha la ni skye 'gag byung gnas 'gro 'ongs la sogs spros pa'i mtshan ma mtha' dag gis dben zhing dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs dngos po'i chos su ma grub pas/ gnas sa gnas mkhan sogs kyi yul las 'das pa ste/ yum las kyang*/ 'das pa'i sems ni mi dmigs pa'o/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems ni ma skyes pa'o/ 270)da ltar gyi sems ni mi gnas pa'o/ zhes sogs dang*/ ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ ces pa ltar/ yod med/ rtag chad 'gro 'ong las 'das pa'i chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa kho na nyid las ma g.yos kyang*/ ci yang med pa'i stong pa phyang chad ma yin par/ gshis stong pa nyid kyi gdangs 'gag pa med pa'i rtsal cir yang 'char ba ste/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ 'gag med cir yang 'char ba de nyid la kun rdzob bden pa zhes bya zhing*/ de la ltar snang tsam du byung gnas 'gro gsum yang yod par grub ste/ sems kyi dang po byung sa ni/ gnas lugs don gyi kun gzhi'i klong nas 'gag med kyi rtsal snang rang ngo ma rig par gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i las rlung gi bskyod pa'i mthus med bzhin snang ba'i cho 'phrul du byung ba yin la/ 271)bar du gnas sa yang gdos bcas kyi phung po 'di nyid la gnas shing khyab/ mthar 'gro sa yang 'chi ba'i tshe lus sems gnyis kyi sbrel thag lta bu rlung dbugs kyi 'gyu ba chad de rnam par shes pa dbang po'i sgo gang rung nas so so'i las dang rjes su mthun par thon nas skye ba phyi ma gar skye'i nying mtshams sbyor ba ste/ de ltar gnas skabs kun rdzob bden pa'i byung gnas 'gro gsum gyi tshul ni de ltar lags mod de/ klong gsal gyi rgyud las/ e ma khams gsum sems can rnams// byung gnas 'gro gsum 'khor mo ru// zo chu'i 'khyud mo bzhin du 'khor// sems kyi byung sa thog ma'i gzhi// sems kyi gnas sa lus kyi rten/

sems kyi 'gro sa rtog dpyod yul/ zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs phyir/ drang don kun rdzob ltar gyi byung gnas 'gro gsum de ltar yin la/ de lta bu med 272)bzhin snang ba'i cho 'phrul khams gsum 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid skye 'chi 'byung 'jug gi 'khrul 'khor zad pa med pa 'di dag kyang*/ don dam pa'i ngo bor gang las kyang ma byung*/ gang du yang mi gnas/ gar yang ma song ste/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ming tsam brda tsam btags pa tsam las/ a 'thas bden grub tu gyur pa ni gang yang ma mchis shing*/ yod med dang bden brdzun kun rmi lam gyi yul snang lta bu las ma 'das la/ bden mi bden du 'dzin byed mkhan po nyid kyang ma grub pa'i khyer/ sher snying las/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid de/ mtshan nyid med pa/ ma skyes pa/ mi 'gag pa/ zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams dang*/ bang mdzod kyi rgyud las/ snang tshul cir yang snang ba ste// yin tshul nges pa med pa yin/ zhes sogs gsungs shing*/ bye brag tu/ nang don nas 273)bshad pa'i skabs kyi sems snying la gnas tshul bshad pa de ni/ sngags kyi bzhed pa khyad par ba yin te/ rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas rtogs pa sems la 'char ba/ zhes gsungs pa'i don ltar/ rdo rje'i lus la gnas pa rtsa dang*/ g.yo ba rlung*/ bkod pa byang chub sems kyi gnas tshul bshad pa'i skabs don yin tshe/ de la rtsa'i gtso bo gsum dang 'khor lnga las gyes pa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis sogs dang*/ de la brten pa'i rlung dang thig le'i gnas lugs sogs rgyud sde tha dad kyi dgongs don rnams gcig tu bsdus nas/ zab mo nang don gzhung 'grel rnams su zhib rgyas gsungs phyir/ 'dir gzhan brjod dgos par ma gyur la/ snying ga'i dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi skabs don ni/ gsar rnying gnyis ga'i rdo rje lus kyi sbas bshad 274)rnams nas gsungs pa ltar/ snying ga dran pa rnam bkod kyi rtsa 'dab rin chen cod pan la sogs sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi 'khor lo'i dbus na/

rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i mdud pa hūm̐ gi dbyibs can gyi phyogs bzhir sbas pa'i rtsa mdud bh+rum̐ aṃ badz+ra khaṃ dang bzhis bskor ba/ de'i dbus na yang rtsa'i dwangs ma brgyad yod pa las/ dbus ma gsum ni chos nyid kyi rtsa yin pas sku gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i rten byed/ mdun na me long ye shes kyi rtsa yod pas ye shes bzhi'i rten byed/ g.yas na yon tan gyi rtsa yod pas dag pa'i zhing dang gzhal yas la sogs 'char gzhi'i rten byed*/ g.yon du 275)dug gsum rang rgyud pa'i rtsa gsum yod pas 'khor ba'i 'khrul rtog las nyon rnams gsal ba'i rten byed pa yod cing*/ bye brag gzhan yang*/ chos nyid kyi rtsa'i nang du 'od ser po la kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas pa'i rten byed cing*/ 'od de ni sha'i dwangs ma las grub pa yin pa dang*/ de bzhin du ye shes kyi rtsa'i nang du dbugs kyi dwangs ma'i 'od mthing ga ni yid kyi rnam shes kyi rten gnas dang*/ yon tan gyi rtsa'i nang du 'od dmar po khrag gi dwangs ma ni nyon yid kyi rten gnas dang*/ rang rgyud kyi rtsa'i nang du drod kyi dwangs ma 'od dmar nag la sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas pa'i rten byed la/ gzhan yang*/ dbus rtsa la rtsa'i snyigs ma las grub pa'i yi ge su dang tri yod pas lha ma yin dang byol song du skye ba'i bag chags kyi sa bon dang rgyu byed la/ de sbyong byed 276)sku'i snying po oṃ yig gnas pa dang*/ mdun rtsa'i nang na dbugs kyi snyigs ma las grub pa'i a dang nri gnyis ni lha dang mir skye ba'i sa bon dang*/ de sbyong byed thugs kyi snying po hūm̐ yig yod/ g.yas rtsa'i nang du khrag gi snyigs ma las pre dang du gnyis yi dwags dang dmyal bar skye ba'i sa bon yod cing*/ de sbyong byed gsung gi snying po āḥyig gnas pa ste/ de ltar ma dag rigs drug gi rgyu dang sa bon gyi yig gzugs de dag las dug lnga dang ser sna sogs nyon mongs pa'i rtog tshogs 'byung ba ni sbyang gzhi dang sbyang bya yin la/

rgyal ba sku gsum gyi snying po 'bru gsum po de las ni bskyed pa'i lha/ bzlas pa'i sngags/ bsgom pa'i ting 'dzin la sogs sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi rnam rol thams cad 'byung ba ni sbyong byed yin zhing*/ de'i mthus sbyang 'bras lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi nus pa mthar 277)phyin tshe rgyal ba sku gsum mngon du 'gyur ba'i gnad don yang 'di nyid yin par gsungs so/ ༈ khyad par du de dag thams cad kyi dbus na/ rtsa dbu ma'i dwangs ma las grub pa'i rtsa mdud bral ma'am/ ka ti shel gyi sbu gu can yang zer/ rtsa'i rgyal po ri bong mig kyang zer/ bha san+dhū yang zer ba ste/ phra zhing mnyen pa/ gsal la dwangs pa/ dar dkar gyi skud pa lta bu'i rtsa sna dbyibs g.yer ma kha bye ba bzhin yod pa de nyid/ phal pa rnams la kha thur du bstan zhing zum nas yod pa/ nyams rtogs can dang skyes chen byang sems rnams kha cung zad bye ba 'phred du bstan pa dang*/ grub pa mthar son pa'am sangs rgyas lta bu rnams la kha bye zhing gyen du bstan nas yod pa'i mthus mkhyen brtse ye shes rgyas par bshad cing*/ rtsa mchog de nyid kyi dbus su gzhi gnas ye shes kyi 278)ngo bo mi bshigs pa'i thig le yungs kar gyi tshad tsam chu shel lam dngul chu g.ya' bral gyi kha dog lta bu dbyibs hūm̐ gi rnam pa can dwangs ma lnga'i 'od kyi ra bas bskor ba yod de/ de ni rig pa ye shes chos kyi sku gdod ma'i gnas lugs don dam pa'i bden pa gsal stong zung 'jug chen por bzhugs ste/ 'di la 'ga' zhig mu stegs rtag lta ba rnams snying gi dkyil du sems kyi dngos po thig le sgo nga 'dra ba bsra 'thas mi 'jig pa lus che chung so sor de nyid kyang che chung de dang mthun pa zhig yod par 'dod/ 'di skabs kyi dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi thig le dang gcig go zhes skur pa 'debs mod kyang*/ 'di ni snang la rang bzhin med pa ye shes lnga rdzogs kyi ngo bo yin tshe/

de gnyis mtshungs pa'i gnas med do/ de yang*/ dpal kun tu kha sbyor gyi rgyud las/ snying ga'i dbus gyur 279)pad+mo ni// 'dab ma brgyad dang lte bar bcas// de yi dbus su gyur pa'i rtsa// mar me lta bur gzugs can te// chu shing me tog lta bu dbyibs// kha ni thur du bltas te dpyang*// de yi dbus gnas dpa' bo ni// yungs kar sbom pa'i tshad tsam ste// hūm̐ gi sa bon mi shigs dang*// kha ba lta bur 'dzag pa nyid// bha san+ta zhes bshad pa yin// lus can rnams kyi snying dga' byed/ ces pa dang*/ klong gsal 'bar ba nyi ma'i gsang rgyud las/ kun gsal ka ti shel sbug can// gzhi gnas ye shes chen po'i sku// pad+mo kha 'bus nang nas bzhengs// dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dbyings su 'char/ zhes pa dang*/ dri ma med pa snying po'i rgyud las/ dhū ti lus kyi srog shing lta// yas man bskyed cing 'khor lo lnga// zangs dung lba ba'i gdugs rtsibs bzhin/ 280)/de yi snying po dwangs ma'i rtsa// dbu ma chos nyid don gyi rtsa// skye ba med pa'i lam chen po// rtsa rnams de las gyes pa ni// dpag bsam shing chen rgyas pa ltar// de dkyil snying gar 'dus pas ni// snying zhes rnam shes srog gi rten// sha yi dwangs ma dbu ma'i rtsa// drod kyi dwangs ma a thung me// thig le'i dwangs ma bde chen haṃ// dbugs kyi dwangs ma srog gi rlung*// yid kyi dwangs ma kun gzhi sems// dwangs ma lnga 'dus ra ba na// snying po ye shes don gyi lha// thog ma'i sangs rgyas spyi mes bzhugs/ ces pa dang*/ snying dkyil rtsa yi rgyal po ni/ ri bong mig ces bya ba yod// g.yer ma'i kha bzhin 'byed 'dzum can// sems can rnams la kha thur blta// snang ba gti mug rnam par 'grib// sgom gyis yon tan grod la bye// 'khor 'das gnyis snang sgyu mar 'char// sangs rgyas 281)rnams la kha yar blta// ye shes snang ba rgyas pa'o/

zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs shing*/ 'di ni rnying lugs gcig pur yang ma zad/ gsar ma'i rgyud sde mang por yang gsungs te/ gong du brjod pa'i kha sbyor gyi rgyud tshig de'i 'phror/ ༈ rtsa yi mdzes spyi las byung ba// de ni rdul bral rab tu grags// dag pa shel gyi 'od dang mnyam// byang chub sems ni 'od gsal ba// ye shes lnga yi dngos nyid de// yung kar gyis ni sbom phra tsam/ zhes sogs dang*/ rim lnga las/ rtag tu snying la gnas pa yi// thig le gcig la 'gyur ba med// de sgom byed pa'i skyes bu la// nges par ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ gzhan yang*/ brtag gnyis las/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ sogs dang*/ sa ra has kyang*/ mkhas pa thams cad bstan bcos 'chad pa na/ 282)/lus la ye shes yod par ma rtogs so/ zhes dang*/ gzhan yang grub thob rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung 'grel man ngag mang por 'di kho na ltar bshad la/ mdor na lus sems rtsa rlung rnams tshogs pa'i rten 'brel las/ snying ga'i dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi thig le 'di ni don dam byang chub sems kyi rten gzhi yin pa'i gnad kyis 'od gsal bsgom pa'i thabs gnad kun snying gar rig pa dang*/ bskyed rim lha'i rnal 'byor thams cad la yang thugs srog sa bon 'ba' shig la brten dgos pa dang*/ sems dpa' gsum rtsegs sogs dang*/ sngags 'phreng bskor ba dang spro bsdu'i ting 'dzin mtha' dag thugs ka nas byed pa yang gnad 'di yin pa dang*/ skye 'gro rnams mthar 'chi ba'i tshe yang rlung sems thig le dang bcas pa snying khar phrad pa'i rkyen gyis/ gzhi gnas kyi 'od 283)gsal 'jag mig gi srin bu yan chad la 'char zhing*/ nyams len gyi nus ldan rnams bar do dang por grol ba'i gnad kyang 'di yin pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ rlung sems dbu mar chud pa'i yon tan thams cad kyang gnad 'di la brten pa'i phan yon du gsungs la/ ༈ rnying lugs las ni/

rdzogs chen skor gyi nyams len man ngag rnams su/ tsit+ta sha'i sgron ma/ dkar 'jam rtsa'i sgron ma/ rgyang zhags chu'i sgron ma/ dbyings rnam dag gi sgron ma/ thig le stong pa'i sgron ma/ shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma ste/ sgron ma drug dang*/ de'i steng du/ gnas lugs gzhi'i sgron ma/ bar do dus kyi sgron ma/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i sgron ma dang bcas te/ sgron ma dgu skor thams cad kyang 'di skabs kyi gnad don 'ba' shig yin pa dang*/ chos bka' de dag gi skabs rnams su/ rnal 'byor pa'i 284)lus la rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lhun grub tu zhugs tshul bshad pa'i skabs su/ snying ga'i dwangs ma lnga 'dus mi shig pa'i thig le ni rgyal ba rigs lnga sogs zhi ba'i lha tshogs bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dang*/ de'i 'od gdangs kyi rtsal las klad pa dung khang na khro ba'i lha tshogs lnga bcu rtsa brgyad dang bcas pa rnams ngo bo sku/ rang bzhin 'od rnam pa thig le dwangs ma'i tshul du bzhugs pa dag chos nyid bar do'i tshe rang snang gi 'jig rten khams kun khengs par 'char ba la/ gdams pa'i gnad kyis zin na grol zhing*/ rang snang du ma shes par gzhan du 'khrul na 'jigs skrag skyes te grol mi thub pa'i tshul sogs rgya cher gsungs shing*/ ngo sprod kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa mchis na'ang chos rgyud gzhan rnams kyis ni spyir rnying ma'i chos dang*/ khyad par rdzogs pa chen po la ni mu stegs pa'i lugs lta bur bltas nas chos 285)kyi khyur yang mi tshud par 'dor mkhan mang ba la/ snying ma bar 'dod pa'i gang zag phal mo ches ni/ bsrung bzlog gsad mnan dang*/ gto mdos rtsis gsum sogs la mgo 'khor zhing*/ de dag gis rnyed pa'i zas nor cung zad rnams kyi bu smad gso ba'i ngang la mi tshe bskyal mkhan sha stag ma gtogs/ zab chos rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len lta zhog glegs bam dag kyang 'bu srin gyi tshang mal du bskyur ba 'di 'dra'i gnas skabs la/

rang nyid skyo shas 'phel ba tsam ma gtogs gzhan thabs kyi dben par zad cing*/ sku nyid lta bu mkhyen rab kyi spyan yangs pa rnams ni/ rnying ma'i yig cha rnams la ma ltos par/ grub chen pak+shi'i bka' 'bum khrod kyi bstan pa mtha' yas rgya mtsho gcig pu la gzigs na lta grub rnams ji lta bar gsal ba dang*/ kun mkhyen 286)rang byung rdo rjes bi ma la zhal gzigs pa'i skabs su mdzad pa'i zab chos karma snying tig gcig pus kyang rdzogs chen snying tig mtha' dag gi dngos don 'khrol nus pa lags mod/ ces 'phros don du gsol ba'o/ ༈ de ltar sems kyi rten gnas snying ga yin par bshad pa'i skabs 'di dang mtshungs par/ tha mal pa rnams kyang lus kyi gnyan sa snying yin par byed cing*/ gso ba rig pa'i gzhung las kyang*/ ji skad du/ dran pa'i dbang po gsal bar byed pa'i rtsa// snying la srid de rtsa bran lnga brgyas bskor/ zhes sogs gsungs pa las kyang*/ tshe dang bla srog gnas pa'i rten yang snying ga yin phyir/ sgral las mkhan po rnams kyi dmigs yul yang der gtod par bshad gda' ba dang*/ gzhan yang*/ gsang sngags 'og ma dag las kyang dgongs don cha mthun phyir/ rnam snang mngon byang sogs las 287) gsungs pa bzhin/ dbang chog mang por/ snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du don dam byang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa sgom tshul sogs gsungs pa de dag kyang snying ga'i mi shig pa'i thig le'i brda don du snang la/ lar/ gsang sngags kyi nyams len mthar phyin tshe rang snang don gyi 'og min du longs spyod rdzogs skur 'tshang rgya bar bde dgyes gsang gsum dang dus 'khor las gsungs pa dang*/ rdzogs chen las snying gar longs sku'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs tshul dang*/ chos nyid bar do'i 'char tshul grol tshul bshad pa sogs thams cad don gyi dgongs pa la khyad par mi 'dug pa dang*/

phyi nang gzhan gsum gnad gcig pa'i mthus/ mi mjed 'dir bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong rnams mngon par rdzogs pa 288)sangs rgya ba'i gnas kyang 'dzam gling gi snying po rdo rje gdan kho nar mdzad pa yang*/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel gnad gcig pa'i rtags yin par gsungs so/ de ltar nyid kyi dri rmad mdzad pa'i lan don gzhan rnams phyogs mtshon tsam phul nas/ da ni sgom phyag rgya chen po dngos gzhi'i skabs don la/ nyid kyi gsung las/ mnyam bzhag gi tshe/ lta stangs nam mkha' dang sa gzhi sogs gang du gtad pa der gnas shing*/ de dang de'i kha dog gsal yang der 'dzin bral bar snang tshul sogs gsungs pa 'di la/ spyir las dang po pa la sgom ma skyes par skye bar byed pa'i thabs kyi rnam snang gi chos bdun dang*/ mig gi lta stangs sogs gal che bar bshad pa dang*/ khyad par zhi gnas mtshan bcas shing bu rde'u sogs la brten nas bsgom pa'i dus su ni mig dang sems rtse gcig tu gtad 289)dgos pa lags shig/ gang du gtad pa'i yul de nyid snang la der 'dzin bral ba de la'ang 'dra min gnyis mchis te/ yul snang la gsal cha'i spu ris ma phyed par hang nge ba'i btang snyoms pa de ni sgom gyi ngo bo ma yin zhing*/ shes pa had po zhes bya ba yin la/ yul snang mtha' dag skyon med du gsal zhing*/ tshogs drug gi 'char sgo thams cad ji lta bar tshor bzhin du/ sems nyid dngul chu sa la 'pho ba ltar lhad med du rang ngo hrig ge rig pa zhig dgos par bzhed de/ de'i phyir zhen 'dzin gyi lhad dang ma 'dres na/ snang yul spang dang dgag pa sogs byed mi dgos te/ sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rang mdangs yin pa'i phyir ro/ de skad du/ te lo zhabs gyis/ snang bas ma bcings zhen pas 'ching*// zhen pa chod cig nā ro pa/ zhes gsungs pa 290)dang*/ mar pas kyang*/ spyir snang ba ji ltar snang lags kyang*// ma rtogs dus na 'khrul snang ste// phyi yul gyi zhen pas 'ching bar byed*/rtogs pa rnams la sgyu mar snang*// yul snang ba sems kyi grogs su 'char// mthar thug don la snang ma myong*// skye med chos skur rnam par dag

ces gsungs pa ltar yin mod kyi/ lar yang*/ gong du bshad pa bzhin zhi gnas kyi skabs rnams su ni mig gi lta stangs sogs gnad che ba'i phyir/ rdzogs chen rnams las kyang*/ sems mi gnas pa gnas par bya phyir nyan thos zhi ba'i lta stangs/ gnas pa brtan par bya phyir byang chub sems dpa'i lta stangs/ brtan par grol bar bya phyir khro bo'i lta stangs sogs rnam grangs du mar gsungs mchis te/ sgom phyag rgya chen po dngos gzhi zhi lhag dbyer med nyams su len pa'i tshe ni/ lta stangs sogs rtsol bcas la rag 291)ma lus pa zhig gal che ste/ rje ko brag pas/ nga phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor pa// lus gnad lta stangs sems 'dzin med// gang shar gyi rnam rtog 'di ka skyong*/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'gro 'dug za nyal thams cad sgom dang bsre dgos phyir/ lus kyi 'dug stangs dang mig gi lta stangs sogs rnam pa kun tu dgos pa ni ma lags so/ ༈ yang nyid kyis// skad cig skad cig la gnas shing*/ skad cig skad cig la 'gyur ba/ zhes sogs gsungs pa la ni/ spyir khrid rim gyi phyag bzhes phal che bar/ dang po ni sngar bshad pa bzhin sems kyi gnas cha gtan la 'beb pa'i thabs du ma'i sgo nas bslabs te/ rnam rtog gi rba rlabs rang sar zhi bar ma byas na/ rang byung gi ye shes rjen pa ngos mi zin pas/ gnas cha'i rim pa rab 'bring tha gsum rgyud la skye dgos par 292)gsungs shing*/ sgom gyi gzhi rten pa yin te/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pas/ sems kyi rta pho srab med de// sngon chad log pa'i lam la rgyugs// da lta yang dag gi thur la zin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin tshe gnas cha ma rnyed par ji ltar sgoms kyang so thub pa cig dka' bar gsungs te/ grub chen o rgyan pas/ dran pas ma zin 'khrul pa'i blo// rig pa 'phyo sang 'khyer ba de// bya spu rlung gi bskyod 'dra'i sems// gnyug ma'i rang sa zin par dka'/

zhes sogs gsungs phyir/ gnas pa la rang dbang thob dgos la/ ༈ 'on kyang gnas pa la de kho na sgom yin par sems shing*/ 'gyur ba sogs gzhan thams cad min par 'dod na lhag mthong ngo mi 'phrod pa'i skyon yin zhing sgom gyi mu ge 'byung bas na/ ༈ gnas na gnas thog tu skyo zhing*/ 'gyu na 'gyu thog tu 293)rang ngo shes par bya ba ste/ rgod tshang pas/ rang gi sems la cer gyi ltos// bltas pas mi mthong dngos po med// med pa'i ngang la lhod de zhog /yal le chad de 'dzin med zhog /yang cig rnam rtog skyes pa na// ngo yis tshir gi bzung mdzod la// kho rang thog tu lhod de zhog /rang sar grol bar the tshom med// phyi yi yul la cer gyi ltos// rang snang sgyu ma lta bu yin// gang shar thog tu 'dzin med zhog /bar gyi rig pa khrol du gzhug /'gyu ba dgos med ser bu 'dra// 'dzin pa ma zhugs 'gyus pas chog /rang ngo shes pas dgag sgrub bral// de la rnam rtog sgom shar zer/ zhes gsungs pa ltar lags tshe dran rig gis zin na 'gyu ba yang sgom las ma 'das pas/ gnas cha yun ring por gnas pa'i nges pa mi 'ong zhing*/ don la 294)gnas 'gyu gnyis ga sgom du 'khyer shes pa zhig gal che ba lags/ yang*/ nyid kyis/ 'gyu rjes su gnas pa de na bun yal ba 'dra ba/ gnas rjes su 'gyu ba de sprin gsar skyes pa 'dra ba/ sogs gsungs pa de ni/ sems nyid kho rang gcig pu ste/ res 'ga' gnas par shar zhing res 'ga' 'gyu bar shar ba ma gtogs sems gnyis ma grub pa'i phyir/ gnas dus na 'gyu mkhan med la/ 'gyu dus na gnas mkhan med de/ don dam par gnas pa dang 'gyu ba sogs cir shar cir snang mtha' dag sems nyid gcig bu'i 'char tshul med bzhin snang ba'i sgyu 'phrul te/ do ha las/ sems nyid gcig bu kun gyi sa bon te// gang las srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ zhes sogs dang*/ rje rang byung gi phyag chen smon lam du/

snang yang sems la stong yang sems nyid de// rtogs 295)kyang sems la 'khrul kyang rang gi sems// skyes kyang sems la 'gag kyang sems yin pas// sgro 'dogs thams cad sems la chod par shog ces gsungs pa dang*/ yang dgon pas kyang*/ blo rtog pa ru 'gyu ba gnas lugs kyi sgo// rang ngo shes pa nyams len gnad/ ces gsungs pa bzhin/ tha mal 'khrul rtog a 'thas kyi dbang du ma shor bar rang rig gi dran pas zin pa zhig dgos pa ma gtogs/ gnas 'gyu gnyis la bzang ngan spong len ni cung zad kyang dgos par ma gsungs te/ 'ba' ra bas/ phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba// logs na yor re ba zhig med// da lta'i snang ba sna tshogs 'di'i// rang ngo skyong ba phyag rgya che// gang shar 'dzin pa med pa la// rang sor skyong ba phyag chen yin// e ma 296)phyag rgya chen po 'di// gnyen pos sna bskyil ma byed par// kha yan skyongs dang gu re yang*// blo yi gnyer kha ma byed par// rang sar zhog dang sos re dal// gang byung cis kyang chog pas na// dgag sgrub med pas khog re yangs/ ces sogs gsungs pa ltar/ sems gnas na gnas thog tu lhod de/ 'gyu na 'gyu thog tu khrol le/ snang na snang thog tu lam me/ gang dang gang ltar 'dug kyang bzo bcos dang spro bsdu sogs kyi sems la las mi bkol bar/ rang la rang gis ngo shes tsam pa'i ngang la gsal te/ rjen ne/ hrig ge gu yangs phyam me bar 'jog pa lags shing*/ 'jog ces bzhag rgyu dang bzhag mkhan tha dad du grub pa med de/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos/ bsam pa thams cad blo yin gyi// blo yi byed pa zhog la thong*// zhog ces 297)bya ba'ang tshig yin pas// tshig gi 'dzin pa bor la thong*/ zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu tshig tu brjod pa thams cad kun rdzob las ma 'das tshe/ don dam pa'i gnas lugs kyi ye shes ni rang gi rgyud thog tu myong dgos phyir/ ming dang tshig gi mtha' la ma zhen pa gal che bar gda' lags/

༈ yang nyid kyi/ rkyen bzang ngan gang yang thug phrad kyi dus su glog 'khyug pa 'dra bar snang*/ gsungs pa la/ ༈ spyir gong du bshad pa bzhin dran rig gis zin pa'i ngang nas ni rkyen snang gang byung thams cad kyang sgom du ma gyur pa med la/ ༈ 'on kyang*/ rang rig rjen la ma bud pa'i gnas nyams 'jam 'bol le ba lta bu zhig la 'byams pa'i 'phror/ rkyen blo bur ba'am/ mi skad khyi skad lta bu zhig byung tshe/ gnas nyams de sad rgyu 298)yod 'dra ba byung na/ tha mal shes pa rjen pa sgom du ma shar bar/ cung zad nyams la zhen pa yin te/ de lta bu'i rigs can rnams ni gnas dben zhing rkyen med par bsgom bde bde 'dra ba zhig 'byung yang*/ sgra skad sogs tshogs drug yul rkyen byung tshe sgom 'thor ba dang*/ de la ni nyid kyis gsungs pa bzhin/ gnas dus la bltas na rkyen gang byung theg pa 'dra la rkyen byung ba'i tshe gnas pas mi sleb pa ni/ zhi gnas rkyang par song ba'i rtags yin par gsungs te/ de lta bu la ni lhag mthong gi nyams len la rtsal 'don dgos pa'i phyir/ ༈ sngon rje phag mo gru pas slob ma la lar sgo 'byed gcod kyi skad chen po yod pa'i 'gram du mal sa byas te bsgom du bcug pas bogs thon pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ 299)dge ba'i bshes gnyen bya yul bas/ slob ma rnams sgom la gnas tshe khong rang rol cha dkrol ba 'ba' zhig mdzad pa'i lo rgyus ltar/ gnas nyams lteng po la mi 'jog par rig pa la dwangs cha 'thon par byas nas rkyen gang byung de dag sgom du 'khyer thub pa zhig nan ltar gal che bas na/ dus nam du yang da lta'i tha mal shes pa rjen pa 'di ga hur re/ hrig ge ba ma gtogs/ gnas nyams ban bun 'am 'ol gyi dbang du mi btang ba gal che bar gsungs te/ lo ras kyis/ gsal cha med pa'i zhi gnas lteng po// bsgom yun ring kyang don mi rtogs kyi// lta stangs rig pa'i ngar dang ldan pas// thun chung 'phro la 'thud kyin sgoms shig

ces pa ltar/ rig pa dwangs cha thon par byas na gnas nyams thom 300)por mi 'chor bar shes pa rjen pa ngos zin/ de ltar ngos zin mkhan de lhag mthong yin zhing*/ sgom gyi gnad thams cad lhag mthong la rag pa nyid dang*/ gzhan yang sdug bsngal lam zhe sdang sogs nyon mongs rags pa rnams/ na tsha sogs thams chad la tshor mkhan gyi rig pa de ka nyams len gyi snying por bya ba ste/ ro snyoms kyi gdams pa yang 'di las spros pa shig med pa dang*/ de ltar gang shar la dran rig gis rang ngo shes pa'i dus na rnam rtog 'khrul phyir 'brang rgyu med tshe/ rnam rtog chos sku'am/ cir snang sgom gyi rang bzhin du mi 'gyur ka med yin la/ de'i phyir mnyam rjes sogs kyi dbye ba mang yang*/ mdor bsdus na rang rig gi dran pa yod med kho na las gzhan ma mchis so/ spyir yang*/ mnyam rjes kyi skabs 'di dag la/ bka' rgyud kyi skyes chen rnams kyi 301)bzhed tshul sna tshogs 'byung ste/ rje rang byung sogs ni mnyams kyi nyam rjes dang*/ rtogs pa'i mnyam rjes sogs dbye bar mdzad pa dang*/ skyobs pa rin po che sogs ni sgom lam 'bring po man chad la rang sa'i mnyam rjes kyi tshul tsam ma gtogs mnyam rjes dngos mi 'byung bar gsungs pa sogs snang zhing*/ gzhan yang*/ phyag bzhes kyi 'khrid tshul dag la spros bral chen por ma slebs kyi bar du mnyam rjes tha dad par thun mtshams bcad te sgom du bcug nas/ spros bral mngon du gyur pa tsam gyi tshe mnyam rjes zung 'jug tu la bzlo bar gsungs pa'i khrid rim snang mod kyi/ gang zag dbang po'i khyad par sogs la dgongs pa yang yin mchi/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi gsungs pa'i phyag chen phal cher du ni/ 'khor 302)'das gnyis kyi so mtshams ni/ 'khrul ma 'khrul lam/ rig ma rig gnyis las 'gro sa med pas na/ mnyam rjes gnyis kyang dran rig yod med kho na la bsdu bar mdzad par snang ste/

tha mal shes pa rjen pa la bzo bcos kyis ma bslad/ 'khrul phyir mi 'breng bar bskyang ba de ji tsam thub thub tu 'phro 'thud cing spyod lam thams cad la bsre gang thub goms su 'jug pa las/ lhag pa'i mnyam bzhag rjes thob gcig mi 'byung bar gsungs so/ ji skad du rig pa ngo sprod cer mthong rang grol las/ rtag chad mtha' brgyad bral ba'i rig pa 'di// gang gi mthar ma lhung bas dbu ma zer// dran rig rgyun chad med pas rig pa zer// stong pa rig pa'i snying po can yin pas// de phyir bde gshegs snying po ming du btags// 'di don shes na shes bya kun gyi 303)rab// de phyir shes rab pha rol phyin pa zer// blo 'das mtha' dang ye nas bral ba'i phyir// de phyir phyag rgya chen por ming du btags// de nyid rtogs dang ma rtogs khyad par las// de phyir kun gzhi zhes kyang ming du grags// bzo med tha mal rang gar gnas dus kyi// shes pa gsal le hrig ge 'di ga la// tha mal shes pa zhes pa ming du btags// ming 'dogs snyan snyan mang po cir btags kyang*// don la da lta'i shes rig 'di ka ste// 'di las gzhan du lhag pa su 'dod pa// glang po brnyed nas rjes 'tshol ji bzhin te// stong gsum 'thags su bran yang rnyed mi srid// sems las ma gtogs sangs rgyas rnyed mi 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ 'khor 'das gnyis po rig dang ma rig gnyis// skad cig gcig gi bar las bye brag med// rang gi sems las 304)gzhan du mthong bas 'khrul// 'khrul dang ma 'khrul ngo bo sems su gcig /'gro la sems rgyud gnyis su ma grub pyir// sems nyid ma bcos rang sor bzhag pas grol// snang ba thams cad sems su rig pa'i ngang*// mthong snang shar yang 'dzin med ye shes yin// snang bas ma 'khrul 'dzin pas 'khrul bas na// 'dzin rtog sems su shes na ngang gis grol/ zhes sogs dang*/ 'di ltar nyams su blangs na kun grol te// dbang po dag la rno brtul med par grol// til dang 'o ma mar gyi rgyu yin kyang*// ma bsrub ma btsir mar khu mi 'byung ltar// 'gro kun sangs rgyas snying po can yin kyang*// nyams su ma blang sems can sangs mi rgya// de phyir rang rig 'di la 'dris par gyis/

ces gsungs pa bzhin yengs 'khrul gyi dbang du ma shor bar rang rig rang ngo shes pa la nyams len gyi snying por bya 305)ba las lhag pa'i sgom rgyu ma mchis pa lags/ ༈ yang nyid kyis/ sgom blo ma skyes par sgom 'byung ba ni dka'/ sgom blo skyes pa yang the tshom par gsungs pa 'di la/ spyir thog mar sgom khrid kyi gdams pa zhu ba'i blo dang*/ bar du nyams len la ma brtson na don mi 'grub phyir rtse gcig tu nyams su len par 'dod pa'i blo sogs ni/ gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus yin phyir/ de lta bu'i blo ni cis kyang dgos shing phan yon yang che ba ste/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ sems kyi the tshom rnam par bsal don du// le lo med par bshes gnyen gdams pa bsten// de ni bdud kyi srung ma nyon mongs 'joms// des ni lta ba'i dri ma sred pa sel// 'dis ni 'gro ba thams cad sgrol la brtson/ zhes pa ltar/ dran 306)pa yengs med kyi bskul ma bral bar bya zhing*/ ༈ sgom dngos gzhi nyid la ni sgom blo'i rtog pa dang*/ sgom yong du re zhing mi yong gi dogs pa'i blo dang bde gsal mi rtog ched du bsgrub blo sogs/ mdor na zhe 'dod dang blo byas kyi rigs mtha' dag pa ni sgom gyi gol sa 'ba' shig yin phyir/ blo bral gnyug ma rang babs rjen par bskyang dgos pa dang*/ sems kyi 'char tshul dang 'dug tshul gang byung de ka rang ngo shes pa des mi chog par/ sgom bzang bzang ba zhig blos bcos nas bsgom pa ni sgom gyi 'ching byed dam/ lhad kyis bslad par 'gro ste/ mnyam med sgam po pas/ sgom chen sgom gyis ma bcings na// gzhan gyis 'ching bar mi 'gyur bas// go ba'i lta ba rgyab tu bskyur// bsgom pa'i nyams myong rmang nas shig 307)ces gsungs pa dang*/ gling ras kyis/ ji srid blo zhen yod kyis bar// 'khor ba'i chu bo sgrol mi 'gyur// 'dzin pa thongs na grol ba'i gnad// zhe 'dod med na sangs rgyas 'grub/

ces dang*/ rgya ras kyis kyang*/ yid la mi byed sgom pa la// blo bcos nas bzhag rgyu mi gda' 'o// sems 'dzin kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// sprang po nga tha mal shes pa skyong*/ zhes sogs dang*/ o rgyan pas/ rnam rtog chos sku'i rol pa la// sems gnas pa rkyang pa chos sku min// yan par thongs la ltad mo ltos// rang ngo shes na de kas chog /nyon mongs ye shes chen po la// gnyen po bsgom pas mi spongs kyi// rang ngo ltos la nyams su long*// rang ngo shes na grogs su 'char// tshogs drug sems kyi 'char tshul la// yul snang bkag pas mi khegs kyi// gsol ba gdab cing nyams su 308)long*// yul snang sgyu ma'i rol par 'char/ zhes dang*/ zhang rin po ches/ zhen med bde gsal mi rtog gnas 'dod na// sgom pa ma bsgom bsgom pa'i bya ba thong*// bsgom dang mi bsgom zhe 'dod bya bral na// bya btang sgom pa sgom pa'i mthar thug yin/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'ba' ra bas/ sems ni ma spro ma bsdu bar// rang ga rnal ma nyid du zhog /bzhag bya 'jog byed med pas na// 'jog mkhan rang ngo shes par mdzod// shes mkhan rang yang blo yin gyi// blo yi der 'dzin med par mdzod// blo dang ma bral sgom pa ni// blo 'das bsgrib pa'i mun chen yin// sgom pa blo bral bsgrubs bsgrubs nas// blo bral blo ru song dogs yod// blo bral nyid kyang ma bsgrub par// blo yi yid byed med par gyis/ ces sogs dang*/ blo yis 309)bsgom du med na yang*// sgom med don la gom su ni// yod pas dus rnams kun tu yang*// ma yengs yang dag dran pa yi// rtsi dang ma bral skyong ba gces// yengs na gnas lugs don mi rtogs// bsgom na gang bsgom mtshan mar 'chor// ma yengs mi sgom so ma'i ngang*// goms par mdzod cig yang dag lam/ zhes sogs sgrub rgyud rnams kyi gsungs sgros las zab cing rgya che ba dpag med 'byung mod kyi/

'gag don gyi snying por/ rang sems kyi 'dug tshul gang dang gang ltar snang ba de ka rang rig dran pas bskyang ba nyid la 'dus pa dang*/ mdor bsdu na mtshan ldan gyi bla ma la sangs rgyas chos kyi skur thag chod pa'i mos gus kyi gsol ba rgyun du gdab/ khams gsum gyi sems can mtha' dag pha mar ma gyur pa med phyir byams 310)snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas rlabs chen gyi smon lam rnam dag 'debs shing*/ dge sbyor gang byed mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don 'ba' zhig ma gtogs rang 'dod kyi mun pa spu tsam mi bya/ na tsha rkyen ngan dgra 'dre sdug bsngal 'chi ba dang bcas la ci byung yang*/ bla ma dkon mchog ma gtogs pa gzhan la mi re zhing*/ cir snang rang gi sems/ rang sems chos kyi sku/ chos sku mtshan ma'i yul las 'das par thag chod kyi nges shes bskyed/ mi tshe rmi lam gyi snang ba yud tsam 'di la don med kyi blo rgya dang bshom ra mang po'i long med pas blo sna nang du bstung*/ ji srid bdag tu 'dzin pa ma zad kyi ring la dkar nag rgyu 'bras kyi snang tshul bslu ba med phyir dge sdig blang dor tshul bzhin du 'bad/ 'dus ma byas kyi don mngon du gyur kyang 'dus byas kyi dge ba khyad 311)du mi gsad par bsag sbyang la ci nus su rems/ nyams len byed long med pa nas nyams rtogs dang*/ grub rtags dang*/ gzhan don sogs 'ong du re ba'i ngar 'dzin gyi khong 'tshang spangs te/ byang chub mngon du ma gyur gyi bar sems dang chos su mi 'bral bar 'bungs shing*/ khyad par du nyam len cung zad bgyis pa la brten nas drod rtags dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthong snang ngag nus gzhan phan gdul bya snyan grags 'du long sogs byung ba la dga' brod dang khengs rloms skyes pas/ rang gzhan 'di phyi thams cad phung la sbyor ba'i chos pa ding sang lhag par mang zhing*/ bar chad dang dngos grub nor ba'i nor tshabs la 'di las che ba gang yang ma mchis kyang*/

de ltar go mkhan dkon par gda' la/ grub rtags kyi mchog tu gyur pa ni 312)bla ma la mos gus/ mched grogs la dag snang*/ sems can la snying rje/ rgyu 'bras la zhib cha/ 'khor ba la zhen log zang zing la dgos med/ rang rgyud la zhi dul/ nyams len la chig dril/ 'di rnams rgyud la je che je 'phel du 'gro ba zhig byung na/ grub rtags de kas chog par gda' yang*/ snyigs dus 'di 'drar chos rgyud dang*/ bla ma dang*/ gang zag sogs thams cad nga bzang kho na 'gran zhing rtsod par byed kyang*/ lag len la chos dang gang 'gal kho na 'gran pa lta bu zhig las ma mchis mod kyi/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ chos skad la rta ri ba bshad cing lag len la khyi mi ri bar snang*/ gsungs pa bzhin bden par 'gyur la/ gzhan yang*/ rgyal sras thogs med pas/ de ring tsam yang mi 'chi'i gdengs med kyang*// gtan tu sdod grabs 313)byed pa'i ngang ring po// 'chi khar brang lag thal mo 'chor nyen gda'/ zhes dang*/ da lta'i sdug bsngal phra mo'ang mi bzod kyang*// rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa'i snying khams can// 'jigs rung ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar 'phyan gda' 'o/ zhes dang*/ dge sbyong chos bzhi bsgrub par dam bcas nas// kha drag dbang che 'dod pa'i nga rgyal can// khas blang thog tu khel bar mi gda' 'o/ sogs dang*/ lto 'grangs nyis mas dros tshe chos pa'i gzugs// rkyen ngan sdug bsngal byung tshe tha mal pa// rang sems chos dang 'dres bar mi gda' 'o/ zhes sogs gsungs pa kho na bzhin yin phyir/ des na/ dpal gtsug lag 'phreng bas/ chos rgyud la bdag gzhan mi byed de// chos min zhig 'dug na gar 314)yang phung*// rang nyid la 'dug kyang 'dor rems dgos/ phyag rdzogs dang dbu ma zhi byed gcod/ sbyor drug dang rim lnga chos drug dang*/ bsre 'pho dang lam 'bras la sogs pa/ tha dad kyi rnam dbye mang na yang*/ 'jug tshul dang 'jug sgo'i rim pa tsam/ rang rang gi don de rtogs tsa na/

thams cad kyang dbyer med mnyam pa nyid/ ces gsungs pa ltar chod kyis go mi chos pa'am mi zab pa zhig med rung*/ gang zag gis go ma chod pa'i skyon gyis/ rang rgyud smin grol du gyur ma nus pa yin tshe/ des na chos lugs gang yin kyang*/ chos dang rang rgyud 'dres nus pa gcig 'bad par zhu/ zhes phyi rabs kyi gang zag rnams la snying thag pa nas gsol ba lags/ de ltar nyid kyi dri ba gnang ba'i lan don rags bsdus rnams 'di dag tu 'dus par mchis shing*/ 'dir ma 'dus pa'i phra zhib 315)kyi gnad rnams ni sngon gyi khrid gzhung gi yi ge spyi dang*/ khyad par rje dgu pas mdzad pa'i phyag chen khrid yig sogs su gzigs pas mthus pa dang*/ gzhan yang rnal 'byor bzhi rim dang*/ sa lam gyi bgrod tshul/ shor gol gyi gegs sel sogs ni bka' brgyud rin po che rnams kyi gsung 'bum dag las rgya cher 'byung ba dang*/ bdag gis kyang go tshod phran bu dag yig cha gzhan du sngar nas bris yod phyir/ skabs 'dir yi ge mang bas ma bkod la/ don gyi snying por ni/ bsgom bya'i blo dang*/ sgom byed kyi sems tha dad du ma lus par/ dbyer med blo zad chos zad gcig ma gtogs/ nyams rim dang sa lam re 'dod dang yid smon gyi dgos pa med pa mkhyen par mdzad du gsol// ༈ e ma/ rgyal ba sras dang sprul par bcas pa rnams// ma lus 'gro ba 'dren pa las gzhan pa'i/ 316)/mdzad pa nam yang yod pa ma yin phyir// rang skal dang mthun chos sgo bsam yas bstan// brjod med brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog /gsung gcig nyid la tha dad skal ba dang*// rjes mthun brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs kyang*// mthar thug snying po don dam bden par gcig /gcig pu de yang 'gro ba'i khams rgyud la// bzod nas gnas pa'i bde gshegs byang chub snying*// dbul po'i khyim gyi gter bzhin ma rig bsgribs// 'khrul rtog sgyu ma'i btson rar rtag tu mnar// thag khra sbrul dang mkhris nad can gyis dung*// ser por mthong bzhin log lam 'khrul pa'i 'gro// sna tshogs sdug bsngal brgyas gzir nyams thag la// skyobs mdzad thar pa'i ded dpon rdo rje 'chang*// gang gi gsung rab rgya mtsho'i bcud kyi snying*// skal bzang tshe gcig bde ster

317)myur lam ni// rab zab smin dang grol byed rnam gnyis la// chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gcig car rdzogs// de phyir snying po'i gnad don ma rtogs na// brjod bya'i yal 'dab rgya cher bskyod byas kyang*// bla med byang chub 'bras bu mi thob phyir// mi pham mgon khyed tshul 'dir don gnyer mdzod// sngon sbyangs 'od dkar bdag khyod the tshom gyi// mun pa'i go skabs rdul tsam ma dmigs kyang*// skal ldan thar 'dod kun+da bzhad pa'i slad// dri ba'i 'od snang spro 'di dam pa'i lung*// chos bzhin dris la chos bzhin lan ldon pa// so so yang dag rig bzhi thob dgos kyang*// shes rab gsum gyi nor dang mi ldan pa'i// ci brtol lan 'dir mkhas rnams bzhad gad gnas/ 318)/bdag 'dra thos pa'i bslab sbyangs ma byas shing*// nges pa'i don la gcig tu mos na yang*// thog med mun chen bag chags ngan goms dang*// rnam g.yeng dkor nag sgrib pas 'thums ches rmongs// rang lo brgyad nas nges gsang lam 'dir zhugs// mtshan ldan mang pos thugs rjes legs bskyangs na'ang*// da dung nyin mtshan 'dra ba tsam zhig kyang*// ma gyur rgan po'i gnas skabs 'di ltar zad// 'jig rten bya ba shes kyang mi shes la// 'dod kyang mi 'dod byas kyang ma byas par// mi lo nyer bdun dben pa brten na yang*// rnal 'byor ma thob rang nyid tha mal lus// de phyir gdams pa'i gnad gsang ji lta bar// smra ba'i rgyu med smras kyang don ldan dka'// 'on kyang khyod gsung mi bzlog blun gtam 'di// yi ger spel la nyes 319)par ma gyur cig /theg pa'i yang rtse gsang sngags smin grol gnyis// snyigs dus skye bos log par spyod mthong tshe// ma gzod drang gtam glang bu'i nga ro 'di// gzhan sde rna ba'i zug rngur ma gyur cig /rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' khyab ma rgan rnams// las nyon rgyu 'bras mi zad 'khrul 'khor gyi// 'phang lo zhig pa'i rdo rje pha lam du// gyur nas thar mchog gling du bgrod byed shog
/sku bzhi dbyer med ye shes rdo rje che// ma lus 'gro ba kun gyis myur thob nas*// nyes mang srid pa'i rgya mtsho dong sprug cing*// gdod ma'i ye shes mngon gyur bkra shis shog

ces myur lam gyi gnad don zab mor gleng bslang du bgyis pa'i tshul 'di ni/ rnam 'dren karma mi pham mgon po'i bka' yis nye bar bskul ba'i mthus/ spong ba'i 320) brtul zhugs la mos pa lam du byed pa'i mi rgan sna tshogs rang grol lam/ ming gzhan karma rig 'dzin rnam pa rgyal bas/ kun ldan lcags pho byi ba'i lo/ smin drug gis nya ba'i zla tshes dkar phyogs mngon par 'phel ba'i dus su dge sbyor gyi thun bar dag la bris pa'i dge bas/ 'gro ba kun kyang tha snyad 'khrul phyir 'breng ba'i lam las bzlog te/ theg mchog smin grol gyi lam bzang dam par 'jug pa mthar son pa'i rgyur gyur cig maṅga laṃ// dge'o//
